title: Working Student (f/m/d) Project Management and Operations Excellence
description:
**Location:** BLN H

**Mode of Employment:** Part-time / Fixed Term

**A Snapshot of Your Day**

Join our dynamic Parts and Repair department at Siemens Energy in Germany as a Working Student, where you will play a vital role in supporting project management initiatives within Gas Services. You will actively engage in tracking milestones, preparing status reports, and coordinating meetings, ensuring seamless communication among stakeholders. Imagine contributing to quality audits and operational excellence projects while enhancing your skills in a collaborative environment. Your efforts will directly support our mission of continuous improvement and operational efficiency, making a real impact on our team and the broader organization.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Support project management activities by preparing presentations, tracking project progress, and reporting updates
* Actively participate in key initiatives, contributing your insights and ideas to drive success
* Coordinate project meetings, prepare agendas, and document action items and minutes for effective follow-up
* Assist in monitoring project milestones, tracking deliverables, and preparing updates for stakeholders
* Support the preparation and compilation of documentation for upcoming internal Quality Audits
* Take ownership of smaller improvement projects within the Parts and Repair business area, contributing to process optimization efforts

**What You Bring**

* Enrolled student in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Project Management, or a related field
* Initial experience in project management, operations, and quality management, gained through internships or university projects
* Availability for up to 20 hours per week, maintaining working student status in Germany
* Strong organizational skills and a solid foundation in project management methodologies
* Proficiency in English and intermediate to advanced German
* Interest in digitalization, AI, and process automation, with a good understanding of quality management principles

**About the Team**

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

**Who is Siemens Energy?**

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

  

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

**Our Commitment to Diversity**

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

**Rewards/Benefits**

* Exciting insights into an international company
* Lay the foundation for your career with us

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

cover_letter_paragraphs: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Working Student (f/m/d) Project Management and Operations Excellence role at Siemens Energy. Through my experience helping scale conversational AI tools, optimizing operational workflows, and building data-driven internal products at Auto1 Group, I have learned that the greatest value comes from combining analytical rigor with practical builder execution. With a Bachelor's degree in Digital Product Management and my ongoing Master's studies in International Business Management in Berlin, I am eager to contribute this hands-on, problem-solving mindset to your team.

In my current role as a Junior Project Manager at Auto1 Group in Berlin, I work closely with product managers, developers, and regional operations leads across nine European markets. Working closely with product, engineering, and regional operations teams across 9 markets, I supported the rollout of an AI voice bot that scaled to route millions of calls, lifting answer rates by 20%. I also maintain knowledge bases for a customer-facing chatbot handling 30,000+ monthly conversations, and built internal web utilities, including an AI conversation evaluation platform and an automated customer offer generator connecting internal systems.

Beyond day-to-day operations, I genuinely enjoy untangling disorganized datasets and creating solutions that make teams more efficient. In my analytics and reporting work, I frequently write SQL queries in Redash and build dashboards across Excel, Tableau, and Looker Studio so stakeholders have dependable, real-time metrics. When off-the-shelf software falls short, I roll up my sleeves to build lightweight internal tools, whether that means connecting internal systems through REST APIs, automating multi-step workflows, or testing and structuring custom evaluation data. Collaborating in an international Berlin environment has also allowed me to work comfortably across languages, using my native Spanish, fluent English, and working German (B1).

What particularly excites me about Siemens Energy is the opportunity to bring this mix of analytical curiosity and builder execution to your team. Thank you very much for taking the time to review my application. I would welcome the chance to speak with you and discuss how my background can support Siemens Energy in this role.

title: Working Student Sustainability Reporting (f/m/d)
description:
* Cabka Group GmbH
* Berlin, Germany

* Presence
* Working student

Cabka develops clever and transformative solutions for shipping goods around the world. We take plastic waste and transform it into reusable transport packaging. This is how we turn the used into the useful. Transformation is our power because we know that while resources are limited, possibilities are endless. Together with our customers, we transform entire supply chains and beyond, combining technology, innovation, and sustainability. To us, success means creating solutions that are optimal for our clients and for the planet. In Cabka we believe that every transformation starts with a group of passionate, dedicated, and innovative people. It is for them that we live a culture of inclusion, respect and trust that is strongly aligned with our values RESPECT, PASSION, CREATIVITY, ACCOUNTABILITY.

**Turning sustainability ambitions into measurable progress starts with the right data. As our Working Student Sustainability Reporting, you will help us turn data into transparency and support the progress of our sustainability initiatives.**

### **Working Student Sustainability Reporting (f/m/d)**

based in Berlin

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

* **Sustainability Reporting:** Support regular internal and external reporting on sustainability KPIs and contribute to the preparation of sustainability-related information.
* **Data Collection & Analysis:** Collect and analyze data for sustainability programs and support ad-hoc analyses of sustainability developments relevant to Cabka.
* **Sustainability Systems:** Maintain systems used to measure and track the progress of sustainability initiatives.
* **Cross-Functional Support:** Provide sustainability-related information to colleagues across different entities and support collaboration on sustainability topics.
* **Administrative Support:** Take on administrative tasks related to the team's sustainability activities.

**Your profile**
----------------

* **Studies:** Currently enrolled at a German university, ideally in Business or Public Administration, Environmental Planning, Engineering or a related field, preferably at Master’s level with a completed Bachelor’s degree.
* **Sustainability Knowledge:** High interest in sustainability reporting in an international corporate environment; previous experience with ESRS, sustainability reporting, data analysis or regulatory publications is beneficial.
* **Analytical & Project Skills:** Advanced analytical skills, an outcome-oriented approach and good project management capabilities.Working Style: Independent, self-motivated and structured, with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* **Communication & Collaboration:** Strong communication skills, persistence and intercultural competence.
* **Languages:** Confident communication skills in both German and English; additional languages are a plus.
* **Systems:** Proficient in MS 365, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Purpose & Impact:** Get involved in a variety of sustainability projects and work on topics that connect sustainability with our business.
* **Learning & Development:** Take responsibility from the start, develop your skills and gain valuable practical experience alongside your studies.
* **International Team:** Work in a multicultural team and collaborate with colleagues across different functions and countries.
* **Room for Ideas:** Bring your own perspective and ideas and help shape how we approach sustainability topics.
* **Modern Workplace:** Enjoy our modern office right on Kurfürstendamm in the heart of Berlin, including our own barista.
* **Benefits:** Attractive compensation, company events and fresh fruit in the office.

We embrace Diversity and Inclusion and are committed to providing equal opportunities to all of our applicants as well as our employees – regardless of race, gender, age, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation and gender identity, disability, cultural, ethnic or national origins. Are you an innovative out-of-the-box thinker with a passion for changing the world to the better tomorrow? **Then we are looking forward to your application!** Please use our online application form to apply.

title: Working Student IT Operations – First Level Support (f/m/x)
description:
**bonial helps you save time, money and paper!**

We are a digital advertising partner for offline businesses - we support retailers in their marketing activities and help them find a new audience. **Would you like to join and be a part of digitalisation of retail?**

bonial is part of Axel Springer SE and is disrupting the retail landscape as the leading "Drive to Store" partner in Germany and France. Through our platforms "kaufDA" and "MeinProspekt" in Germany, and “Bonial” in France, we connect millions of users with their favorite shops and brands—driving real impact every single day.  
We are in the midst of an exciting growth phase, scaling fast and transforming the way people discover retail. At bonial, we thrive in a high-performance, fast-paced environment fueled by motivated, results-driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference. If you’re looking to be part of a dynamic team that’s shaping the future of retail, we’d love to meet you.

**About The Role**

Our IT Operations team keeps our colleagues productive every day. As a Working Student, you will be a first point of contact for IT questions and issues, supporting users across Microsoft 365 and Windows & macOS devices. You will gain hands-on experience in a modern IT environment and work closely with experienced IT professionals who are happy to share their knowledge.

**Your responsibilities:**

* **First level support:** Act as the first point of contact for employee IT requests via the ticket system, Slack, and in person; analyze, solve, or escalate issues to second level support.
* **Microsoft 365:** Support users with Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Office apps; assist with account setup, licenses, mailbox and group management, and MFA.
* **Slack:** Help with user onboarding and offboarding, channel and workspace questions, permissions, and integrations.
* **Laptops (Windows & macOS):** Set up, configure, and hand over laptops; install software and updates; troubleshoot hardware, connectivity, and peripheral issues.
* **On-boarding & off-boarding:** Prepare equipment and accounts for new joiners and handle device returns and access removal for leavers.
* **Asset management:** Keep the hardware and license inventory accurate and up to date.
* **Documentation:** Write and maintain clear how-to guides, FAQs, and knowledge base articles for users and the team.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identify recurring issues and help improve processes, self-service options, and the overall user experience.

**Your profile:**

* Enrolled student in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* First experience in IT support, helpdesk, or a comparable role is a plus.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Slack.
* Confidence using and troubleshooting both Windows and macOS.
* Strong service mindset, patience, and the ability to explain technical topics in simple terms.
* Structured, reliable, and independent way of working.
* Very good English skills; German is a plus.
* Availability of up to 20 hours per week during the semester.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with device management tools (e.g. Microsoft Intune, Jamf, or similar).
* Experience with ticket systems such as Jira Service Management.
* Basic scripting knowledge (e.g. PowerShell, Bash).

**What We Offer:**

**High growth story** - bonial is a high-growth and dynamic company with continuous potential into the future. We are a leading player and a driving force in an industry that is undergoing a massive and a once-in-a-lifetime shift from print to digital.

**Innovation & tech** - we are a high-tech company focused on innovative technology, leveraging AI and other tools to maximize productivity and efficiency. We leverage these tools to continually enhance the performance of our company and our people, while driving results for our customers and users.

**Exciting environment for professional development** - strong support for your professional development, backed-up by a feedback culture to help you identify your strengths and opportunities.

**Diversity** - proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where we aim to enable everyone to show up as their full selves. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and to being a safe space regardless of race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender, gender identity or gender expression.

**Wellbeing** - we believe mental health is as important as being fit. That's why we're giving you free access to nilo.health, a mental health app. In terms of physical training, other than our awesome gym in the office, we also cover part of the subscription to the Urban Sports Club. We can also offer you a corporate pension scheme so you don't have to worry about your retirement.

**Sustainability** - together with our Green team, we offer you the opportunity to engage in projects that promote sustainability, environmental development and the impact that we make on our planet.

**Flexibility** - Currently, we have a policy that allows for up to 20% mobile work, which can be conducted from anywhere within Germany, and the option to work from abroad. Additionally, we offer 28 days of holiday. You also get an extra day for each calendar year (up to 30 days) as well as other occasions (moving, working on a social project, etc).\*

**Modern office** - Zen Rooms where employees can pray, relax or simply have some quiet time; fully equipped gym in the office, and a roof terrace for amazing social events.

**Free lunch** – whenever you’re at the office, we offer you different lunch options – and it’s all on us! Enjoy your lunch at a nearby restaurant that partners with us! Hot and cold drinks, fruit, regular varied and healthy breakfasts and other snacks at the office are, of course, always available for free for our employees.\*

**Social Culture** – which encourages people to start conversations, build relationships and participate together in the community through regular team events.

**Partner for retail** - we empower retailers to reach their customers in the most efficient and effective way possible. We see ourselves as a critical business partner for retail, and as highlighted in our Company Vision, we “Enrich local shopping for everyone. Everyday.”

As part of the Axel Springer Group, we also align with the Axel Springer Essentials.

**If you think you could fit the bill, we'd love to hear from you!**

You can check out our bonial\_people Instagram or read more about bonial culture and tech on Medium.

* as per our current Works Agreements

title: Working Student (w/m/d) - SAP HANA Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**Job Description**

**What you bring**

Don't worry if you don't check every box - we'll teach you what you need to know!

* Currently enrolled at a university or university of applied sciences in computer science, information systems, or a related field
* Basic programming knowledge - preferably Python or Go
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - if you've logged in and provisioned a few resources, that's a good start!
* Bonus: Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) or agentic AI
* Curiosity, willingness to ask questions, and a collaborative mindset
* (Very) good English language skills
* Working from the office in Berlin is required

**What you'll build**

As a working student (f/m/d), you'll learn and contribute to cloud infrastructure projects. Your focus will be:

* Learn and support the development of tooling around cluster lifecycle management across multiple cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Contribute to our automation initiatives that accelerate Kubernetes cluster lifecycle management
* Extend and maintain Python and Go (cli-) tools
* Help explore and implement meaningful solutions leveraging AI to further automate our infrastructure processes

You'll be mentored by experienced developers who will help you understand the concepts and grow your skills. Your working hours will be flexible with a maximum of 20 hours per week during the semester (hourly wage), and up to 40 hours during semester breaks.

**Where you belong**  
Our team is part of the Database Cloud Infrastructure (DBCI) unit within SAP HANA Cloud. We're the team responsible for landscape lifecycle management- which means creation, upgrade, and cleanup of interconnected Kubernetes clusters across multiple regions and cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) so that SAP HANA Cloud can run reliably worldwide.

*Your set of application documents should contain a cover letter, a resume in table form, school leaving certificates, certificate of enrollment, current university transcript of records, copies of any academic degrees already earned, and if available, references from former employers (including internships). Please also describe your experience and skills in foreign languages and computer programs / programming languages.*

*This is a SAP global, strategic, paid working student position that provides students with opportunities to find purpose in their careers.*

You will help provision and hand over VS-TOP laptops for secure mobile working. You will also support our Berlin team with guided tours and hands-on infrastructure tasks, including installing and configuring new hardware, adapting existing systems, and documenting technical changes.

**What you’ll bring**

You're a student ready to contribute alongside your studies. You're curious, adapt quickly, and stay resilient as priorities evolve. title: Card Operations Working Student
description:
Solaris is Europe’s leading embedded finance platform, pioneering Banking-as-a-Service to bridge the gap between financial technology and licensed banking. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Berlin, Solaris enables fintechs, digital ecosystems, and multinationals to embed accounts, cards, lending, and payments directly into their own products, creating seamless financial experiences for their users. As a fully licensed German bank, Solaris combines the highest standards of IT security and regulatory resilience with a modular, highly scalable infrastructure.

Today, Solaris is driving the next evolution of financial services by transitioning into an AI-native banking platform, ensuring European businesses can deploy secure, adaptable financial products at scale.

#### **Why join Solaris?**

* We are fundamentally redesigning banking processes around AI orchestration, standardized modular building blocks, and embedded regulatory compliance.
* We combine tech and banking in dedicated hubs - driving the technology infrastructure out of Berlin and banking operations out of Frankfurt.
* Through our internal mobility, growth opportunities, and the Solaris Academy, we offer continuous learning tracks, AI ambassador mentorship, and upskilling to keep your skills ahead of the curve.
* + ️ We foster a workplace rooted in integrity, proactive risk management, and equality actively driving initiatives like DEI initiatives.

#### **Your Role**

* Provide 2nd level support by processing tickets of all cards related issues and process Card Returns.
* Help achieve the team’s OKRs

#### **We'd love to see**

Depending on your level of experience, your responsibilities and scope of role will range. We don’t care much about fancy titles, but rather about real personal and professional development, as laid out in our learning framework. Let’s figure together out how you can contribute to our team.

* You are currently a university student of a relevant discipline - Economic, Maths, Finance, Data Science etc.
* Google suite and MS office. SQL is a plus.
* You manage yourself and prioritize your tasks effectively.
* Fluent command of English. German language skills at minimum B1.
* Energetic and hands-on team player with excellent communication skills, who leverages empathy and persuasion.
* Creative and solutions-oriented, able to tackle complex challenges with practical problem-solving and an adaptable mindset.
* Comfortable working with AI tools, thinking critically about AI outputs, and contributing to a culture of responsible AI use. We expect you to demonstrate comfort with AI-assisted workflows and a willingness to continuously develop their AI capabilities as the technology evolves.

#### **Benefits**

* Transparent framework to support your career goals
* Lunch reimbursement
* Flexible working model

  

*While job ads usually paint an ideal picture of a candidate, studies show that most applicants meet an average of 60% of the criteria. Unfortunately, many promising candidates tend to apply only if they meet all the criteria. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single item in the job description, please contact us anyway. We'd love to talk with you and find out if you might be a good fit for us.*

At Solaris, we are committed to nurturing an inclusive environment, where all Solarians feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to building a diverse workforce that reflects the diversity of our communities. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of color, ethnicity, religion, sex, origin, disability, marital status, citizenship, or gender identity. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

If your application is successful, you will be required to complete pre-employment background checks through our screening provider Zinc. These include, but not limited to identity verification, educational records, references, a criminal record check, etc. The processing is based on Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR. Please see below Privacy Information for Job Applicants for details, including recipients, retention, and your rights.

  

Information on data processing:

DE: https://www.solarisgroup.com/gdpr\_notice\_de  
EN: https://www.solarisgroup.com/gdpr\_notice\_en

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) AI & Automation – Customer Experience
description: Details about the job offer Explore AI. Automate processes. Shape the future of Customer Experience. Are you passionate about artificial intelligence, curious about emerging technologies, and eager to put your academic knowledge into practice? Then join our team as a Working Student AI & Automation – Customer Experience (m/f/d) ! At IFA, you will help us make customer service smarter, faster, and more efficient for visitors and exhibitors through AI and intelligent automation. Working closely with our team, you will develop and test AI-powered solutions, improve digital workflows, and gain hands-on experience with modern technologies. What makes this role special: You won't be working in traditional customer support. Instead, you'll help shape what customer service looks like in the future. Your mission AI & Process Optimization: Support the analysis of existing customer service processes and identify opportunities to improve them through AI and automation. AI Agents & Chatbots: Assist in developing, setting up, and testing AI-powered solutions for common customer inquiries, such as ticketing, invoices, and exhibitor portal access. Workflow Automation: Help automate repetitive tasks, including inquiry categorization, automated routing, and AI-generated response suggestions. Systems & Integrations: Support the integration of AI solutions with our existing digital tools and platforms, including ticketing systems, CRM, and the exhibitor portal. Knowledge Base & AI Content: Help build and maintain our knowledge base, structure content, and prepare reliable information for AI applications. Testing & Optimization: Test new features, analyze results, and contribute ideas to continuously improve our digital services. AI Trends & Innovation: Explore emerging AI tools and technologies, experiment with new applications, and help evaluate their potential for practical use. Documentation & Team Support: Document your work and support the team in adopting and using new digital solutions. Your profile You are currently enrolled at a university, interested in AI, digital technologies, and automation, and excited to contribute your ideas in an innovative environment. You don't need to be an AI expert. What matters most to us is your curiosity, motivation, and willingness to learn. Ideally, you bring the following: You are studying Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, Digital Business, or a related field. You are interested in generative AI, ChatGPT, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI agents, and ideally have already experimented with some of these technologies. Initial experience with Python, JavaScript, APIs, or automation tools is a plus, but not required. You enjoy understanding digital processes, solving technical challenges, and experimenting with new tools. You are interested in how technology can improve customer service and the overall customer experience. title: Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations
description:
**Du möchtest dazu beitragen, aus vielen Gesellschaften eine integrierte, skalierbare und zukunftsfähige Finance-Plattform zu formen? Dann suchen wir genau Dich, zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als:**  
  
**Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations**

Als Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion. Du berichtest an unserem VP Finance Operation und arbeitest eng mit unserer Director FP&A, unserem CFO, sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass gruppenweite Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Projekte erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Dabei entwickelst du unsere Finance-Organisation gezielt weiter: Du koordinierst Finance-Projekte, begleitest die Integration neuer Gesellschaften, harmonisierst Prozesse und schaffst die Grundlage für eine skalierbare Finance-Plattform. Dafür brauchen wir deine Unterstützung!

Die **Arsipa Gruppe** ist eine schnell wachsende, PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

**Deine Aufgaben:**

**Finance Integration & Post-Merger-Integration**

* Die Finanzintegration neuer Tochtergesellschaften im Rahmen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich und begleitest sie von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung.
* Neue Gesellschaften unterstützt Du bei der Einführung und Umsetzung gruppenweiter Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Systeme.
* Integrationsmaßnahmen und relevante Meilensteine verfolgst Du strukturiert nach und stellst einen transparenten Projektfortschritt sicher.
* Abhängigkeiten und Handlungsbedarfe identifizierst Du frühzeitig und steuerst notwendige Eskalationen mit den relevanten Stakeholdern.

**Finance Transformation & Standardisierung**

* Gruppenweite Finance-Projekte und Transformationsinitiativen steuerst und koordinierst Du über verschiedene Gesellschaften und Fachbereiche hinweg.
* Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Reporting-Strukturen entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit den relevanten Teams kontinuierlich weiter.
* Optimierungs- und Standardisierungspotenziale innerhalb unserer Finance-Landschaft identifizierst Du und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.
* Die Weiterentwicklung skalierbarer Finance-Strukturen und Systeme begleitest Du mit Blick auf die Anforderungen unserer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe.

**Stakeholder- & Projektmanagement**

* Eng arbeitest Du mit unserem VP Finance Operations, Director FP&A, CFO sowie den Geschäftsführungen und Finance-Teams unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen.
* Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinierst Du die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Group Accounting, Group Controlling / FP&A und den lokalen Gesellschaften.
* Unterschiedliche interne und externe Stakeholder bringst Du zusammen und sorgst für klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Abstimmungen und nächste Schritte.
* Relevante Projektfortschritte, Entscheidungsbedarfe und Risiken bereitest Du transparent auf und kommunizierst diese an die beteiligten Stakeholder.

**Deine Startvoraussetzungen:**

**Das bringst Du mit:**

* Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Finance-Umfeld mit fundiertem Verständnis von Accounting- und/oder Controlling-Prozessen bildet Deine fachliche Grundlage.
* Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Projekte sowie im souveränen Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern bringst Du mit.
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten sowie Freude daran, Veränderungen aktiv voranzutreiben und unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzubringen, zeichnen Dich aus.
* Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse sowie eine strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise runden Dein Profil ab.

**Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein:**

* Erfahrung in den Bereichen Finance Transformation, Finance Excellence, CFO Office oder Consulting wäre von Vorteil.
* Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) sind wünschenswert.
* Erfahrung in einem PE-finanzierten, Multi-Entity-, Buy-&-Build- oder vergleichbaren Wachstumsumfeld wäre ein Plus.
* Erfahrung bei der Standardisierung, Digitalisierung oder Skalierung von Finance-Prozessen und -Systemen würde Dir den Einstieg erleichtern.

**Unsere Benefits:**

* **Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld:** 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei, ein hybrides Setup mit einem Homeoffice-Tag pro Woche sowie ein zentral gelegenes Office im Rocket Tower inklusive Gym, unmittelbar an der U-Bahn-Station „Kochstraße“.

* **Starke Teamkultur:** Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen Stand-ups, monatlichen All-Hands Meetings und gemeinsamen Events zur Förderung einer positiven und kollegialen Arbeitsatmosphäre.
* **Direkte Nähe zur Finance-Führung und zum Business:** Du arbeitest eng mit unserem VP Finance, dem CFO sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und unterstützt aktiv den Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion.
* **Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Buy-&-Build-Plattform:** Du gestaltest Prozesse, Strukturen und strategische Initiativen in einer krisensicheren, rasant wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe aktiv mit und erhältst Einblicke in die Umsetzung einer Roll-up-Strategie – unterstützt durch einen der weltweit führenden Investoren, Warburg Pincus.
* **Einblicke in die Finance-Transformation einer PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe:** Von der Integration neuer Gesellschaften über die Standardisierung von Prozessen und Systemen bis hin zu Reporting-, Governance- und Skalierungsprojekten wirkst du an zentralen Finance-Initiativen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie mit.

**Unser Bewerbungsprozess:**

* **Kurzes Telefonat** mit dem Group Talent-Acquisition-Team der Arsipa Gruppe.
* **Interview** mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner\*innen aus dem Group Finance Operations Team.
* **Persönliches Kennenlernen** mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner\*innen aus dem Group Finance Operations Team.

Für weitere Fragen stehen wir Dir gerne jederzeit zur Verfügung!  
Du erreichst das Group Talent-Acquisition-Team der Arsipa-Gruppe unter **talent@arsipa.de****.**

title: Working Student, Legal & Privacy (d/f/m)
description:
Kleinanzeigen is the leading online classifieds market in Germany. Users buy and sell on Germany's No. 1 for classifieds mainly second-hand. In this way they make an active contribution to more sustainability. On average, more than 55 million ads are available in numerous categories – from children's supplies to electronics and real estate. Kleinanzeigen also offers small and medium-sized businesses the opportunity to present their services online. Around 35 million users per month make Kleinanzeigen one of the most widely used websites in Germany. Kleinanzeigen was launched in September 2009 as eBay Kleinanzeigen. Since June 2021, the company has been part of Adevinta, a global provider of online classified ads. In May 2023, the name was changed to Kleinanzeigen.
  
  
The Job:
  
As a Working Student Legal & Privacy, you will get hands-on experience of how an in-house legal function supports one of Germany’s leading online marketplaces. As part of our Legal & Privacy team, you will work on topics ranging from contracts and data protection to platform regulation while helping us continuously improve how we work. You will collaborate with colleagues across Kleinanzeigen and explore how AI can make legal work smarter and more efficient. This is a hybrid role, our current office is in Berlin-Charlottenburg and we will be moving to the Ostbahnhof area in Q1 2027.

  

**Who You Are:**

* You are currently studying Law, Business Law, Legal Management, or a related subject at a university in Germany.
* You are interested in legal topics such as contracts, data protection, and platform regulation and curious about how legal teams support a digital business.
* You work in a structured, reliable, and detail-oriented way, take initiative, and handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
* You communicate confidently in German and English and are comfortable managing different tasks and deadlines.
* First practical experience in a legal department, law firm, compliance, contract management, procurement, or legal operations is a plus. Experience with AI tools, contract databases, document management, or workflow tools is also welcome.

  

**What You’ll Do:**

* Support our legal and contract processes from intake and approvals through to signature, helping us keep track of documentation and deadlines.
* Review and prepare standard contracts, contract summaries, and other legal documents with guidance from our experienced lawyers.
* Research legal topics, including developments relevant to digital marketplaces, and turn your findings into clear and concise summaries.
* Maintain our contract database, trackers, legal tools, and digital files, ensuring information is accurate, structured, and easy to find.
* Help improve legal templates, internal guidance, and operational processes, including exploring and testing AI-supported workflows.
* Support the team with a variety of legal and operational projects while collaborating with colleagues across Kleinanzeigen.

  

At Kleinanzeigen, we care about our people — their wellbeing, growth, and life beyond work. Our benefits are designed to support you holistically, giving you flexibility and opportunities to thrive.

  

✨ Flexibility

* Flexible working time (hybrid)
* 20 days “work from anywhere”
* Paid additional parental leave for both parents
* Extra paid days off for special occasions (e.g. your wedding or a move)

❤️‍ Wellbeing & Support

* Confidential support & coaching for you and your loved ones
* Annual company sports events
* Pension and life insurance

Growth & Development

* Personal development budget
* Learning opportunities to grow your skills and career

️ Perks & Everyday benefits

* Corporate benefits and exclusive discounts
* An attractive referral program
* Flexible monthly benefits via our benefits platform, allowing you to choose between mobility, shopping vouchers, fitness options and more.
* Free shipping on Kleinanzeigen Direktkauf

  

Kleinanzeigen is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome people of all backgrounds, races, religions, colours, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientation, ages, marital status, or disability.

If this role sparks your interest but you’re not sure you meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you anyway.

title: Working Student - Technical Equipment Coordinator (m/f/d)
description:
Requisition Number: 80040

**The company built on breakthroughs.**  
**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.

**Your Responsibilities:**
--------------------------

**Management and Maintenance of Test Equipment:**

* + Ensure the availability and functionality of test equipment.
  + Organize calibrations, repairs, and regular maintenance.
  + Create and maintain an inventory of test equipment.

**Shipping of Test Equipment and Product Samples:**

* + Coordinate the shipment of test equipment and product samples to internal and external partners.
  + Monitor returns and perform condition checks.
  + Ensure timely delivery and proper documentation.

**Building and Evaluating Prototype Setups:**

* + Assemble and mock-up samples, in the area of structured fiber optic cabling.
  + Evaluate the feasibility of new designs and assess the functionality of existing products in new applications.
  + Provide detailed feedback and recommendations for improvements.
  + Work closely with the Engineering Services team to refine product handling methods and procedures.

**General Administrative Tasks for the Team:**

* + Support the team with organizational and administrative tasks (e.g., scheduling, documentation, minute-taking).
  + Manage material orders and resources.
  + Communicate with internal and external stakeholders.

**Your Profile:**
-----------------

  

* Studying a technical field, preferably with experience in test equipment and practical cabling installation.
* Familiarity installation processes, test equipment, sample mockups.
* Structured and independent working style with excellent organizational skills.
* Strong communication abilities and a team-oriented mindset.
* Proficient in MS Office; experience with ERP and/or inventory management systems is an advantage.
* Excellent written and verbal proficiency in both German and English.

**What We Offer:**
------------------

  

* An exciting position in an innovative and growing company.

title: Working Student - Learning & Development
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

At BCG, the continuous personal and professional development of our people is a top priority. As a **Working Student in the Learning & Development (L&D) team**, you’ll support the delivery of high-quality training experiences across Central Europe. You’ll work alongside an experienced and collaborative team to help ensure our trainings run smoothly — both behind the scenes and occasionally on site. From logistics coordination to data and overall team support, your contribution will help shape the learning journey.

* Assist with the preparation, conduction, and follow-up of training programs for our consulting and business services teams
* Support the CE L&D team in daily delivery excellence and occasionally more project-related work e.g., our AI upskilling initiatives
* Help creating and updating participant lists, preparing training materials, and ensuring the training setup is ready
* Maintain training data in internal systems e.g., team calendar and training database
* Help manage and track training feedback and assist with basic analysis
* Take care of training equipment, ensuring everything is in working condition
* Occasionally support trainings on site e.g., room setup, welcoming trainers/participants, trainer equipment, etc.

**You’re good at**

* You bring strong organizational and administrative skills and a service-oriented mindset with curiosity for AI and new ways of working
* You work reliably, with attention to detail, and can adapt when plans change
* You’re a team player who enjoys working with people across different locations
* You have a hands-on mentality and are happy to step in wherever support is needed
* Ideally, you have first experience in related fields and event coordination

You can work up to 20 hours/week during your semesters and up to 40 hours/week during your vacation time. The role offers enough flexibility to combine personal, academic and professional life, with an expected workload of approximately two working days per week. This is a temporary role from min. 12 to max. 24 months. You need to be an enrolled university student in Germany.

What You'll Bring

* You are enrolled at a (vocational) college or university.
* You’ve already completed internships or otherwise acquired practical work experience in the field of HR.
* You’re able to work proficiently with the software in the MS Office package and have a natural aptitude for latest tools and learning trends
* Very good written and spoken German and English language skills complete your profile.

Who You'll Work With

You’ll be part of the Central Europe Learning & Development team, where collaboration, mutual respect, and trust shape how we work together.

You’ll work closely with our European and Global Learning & Development teams as well as local HR colleagues, gaining valuable insights into different areas of Learning & Development and HR.

You’ll report to the Central Europe Learning & Development Manager, who will support you throughout your onboarding and professional development at BCG.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Working Student Strategic Purchasing (m/f/d)
description:
**Build a career powered by innovations that matter!** At Novanta, our innovations power technology products that are transforming healthcare and advanced manufacturing—improving productivity, enhancing people’s lives and redefining what’s possible. We create for our global customers engineered components and sub-systems that deliver extreme precision and performance for a range of mission-critical applications—from minimally invasive surgery to robotics to 3D metal printing.

Novanta is one global team with over 26 offices located in The Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Looking for a great place to work? You have found it with a culture that embraces teamwork, collaboration and empowerment. Come explore Novanta.

This position is part of **Novanta’s Advanced Surgery (AS) business unit** , a leader in the field of minimally invasive surgery. Our mission is to develop innovative medical devices and accessories that enable surgeons to perform procedures through smaller incisions, helping improve patient outcomes and recovery times.

  

Our portfolio includes advanced camera systems, insufflators, medical pumps, and specialized tubing solutions that support both diagnosis and treatment. By expanding body cavities and facilitating access during surgery, our technologies help transform complex procedures into less invasive interventions. Working closely with customers, physicians, and technical experts, we continuously strive to advance surgical innovation and improve healthcare worldwide.

**Job Summary**

  

As a **Working Student Strategic Purchasing** , you will support our team of Strategic Buyers (Category Leaders) in managing supplier relationships, analyzing sourcing markets, and driving procurement initiatives. You will take ownership of a spend category and/or contribute to key strategic projects within one of our business segments, gaining valuable hands-on experience in a global and innovative environment.

**Primary Responsibilities**

  

* Analyze sourcing markets and build expertise in supplier landscapes and industry trends.
* Support the development and execution of sourcing strategies that foster innovation, optimize costs, and strengthen supplier partnerships.
* Assist in preparing for and participating in supplier negotiations.
* Support indirect purchasing activities and help manage procurement-related expenses through our global expense management tools.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams across the organization.
* Work closely with R&D and other stakeholders to identify and commercialize new technologies, materials, and supplier opportunities.
* Build and maintain productive relationships with internal and external partners.
* Learn and apply strategic procurement best practices and tools, including purchase-to-pay processes, logistics concepts, and value stream mapping.
Support additional tasks and projects as assigned by the manager.  

  

**Required Experience, Education, Skills, Training and Competencies**

  
Currently enrolled in a Master's degree program in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Purchasing, or a related field, or possess equivalent knowledge and experience.  

  

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel; experience with Power BI is an advantage.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills combined with a proactive mindset.
* Ability to quickly learn new systems, work independently, and contribute effectively as part of a team.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in both German and English.  

Novanta is proud to be an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, military and veteran status, disability, genetics, or any other category protected by federal law or Novanta policy.

Please call +1 781-266-5700 if you need a disability accommodation for any part of the employment process.

title: Working Student – Compliance Automation & AI (m/f/d)
description: About Us Pliant is a modular B2B payments platform combining commercial card issuing, payment accounts, FX and spend management for businesses and AI agents. Businesses across travel, e-commerce, insurance and AI-native technology use Pliant to manage complex payment workflows, while fintechs, software platforms and banks use its infrastructure to build and operate their own commercial payment offerings. Pliant's API-first platform also enables AI agents and applications to access regulated payment infrastructure with permissions, controls and auditability built in. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Berlin, Pliant serves businesses and partners across Europe and North America. A principal member of Visa and Mastercard, Pliant issues commercial cards in 13 currencies across 32 countries under its European e-money license and through regulated partners in the UK and US. Learn more at www.getpliant.com. About The Role We are looking for an exceptional working student to join our team — someone who wants to build expertise in fintech and banking, sharpen their analytical skills, and work alongside senior specialists on critical operational risk topics. As a Working Student – Compliance Automation & AI (m/f/d) , you’ll sit at the intersection of fintech, data, and operational risk management. You’ll work on high-impact tasks in client onboarding, risk profiling, and transaction surveillance — while leveraging data-driven applications, Python, and AI tools to enhance efficiency and insight. You’ll collaborate closely with our Compliance, Risk, Product, and Engineering teams, gaining hands-on experience in one of Europe’s fastest-scaling fintechs. This role is Berlin-based with the ability to work at least 2 days per week from our Berlin HQ. What You’ll Do Onboarding, Risk & Transaction Surveillance Verify corporate clients (KYB), identifying legal representatives and beneficial owners through global databases and registries. Assess customer risk profiles using structured data, defined frameworks, and regulatory guidelines. Review AML alerts from monitoring systems, flag anomalies, and escalate potential cases to senior specialists. Analyze transaction patterns to detect suspicious behaviors or potential financial crime indicators. Prepare and maintain accurate digital credit files in compliance with internal policies. Contribute to the refinement of detection rules to reduce false positives and improve monitoring effectiveness. Data & Technology Integration Work with data-driven applications to support decision-making in compliance and monitoring. Use Python for data analysis, workflow automation, and reporting. Process Innovation Collaborate with Product and Engineering to improve tools, workflows, and system logic. Suggest automation opportunities and AI-driven enhancements. Hands-on automation experience (n8n, Make, Zapier, or code-based pipelines), including API integrations. Proficiency in Python and SQL. Practical experience with LLMs and prompt engineering. Structured, detail-oriented, and disciplined about testing and documenting what you build. Fluent in English; German or other European languages are a plus. Nice to have Interest in fintech and curiosity about compliance topics such as AML/KYC and sanctions screening. Regulatory knowledge is not required; you'll learn it on the job. Experience with data analysis, visualization, or BI tools such as Metabase. Experience with Taktile or other rules engines, or with KYB/registry/Google Maps APIs. Familiarity with Git and AI coding tools such as Claude Code. title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Data, Controlling & KPI-Reporting
description: Einarbeitung (Monat 1–2): Du lernst unsere Datenquellen, KPIs und bestehenden Auswertungen kennen und erstellst die Reports zunächst gemeinsam mit unserem Team, dann zunehmend selbstständig. Deine Aufgaben Tägliches KPI-Reporting: Du stellst dem Head of KAM jeden Tag alle benötigten Auswertungen bereit: aktuell, korrekt und auf den Punkt. Kennzahlen im Blick: Du verfolgst die wichtigsten KPIs und vergleichst sie mit den Vorwochen und dem Durchschnitt. Proaktive Abweichungsanalyse: Weichen Zahlen ab, meldest Du das von Dir aus und ordnest ein, was dahintersteckt. Ursachen finden, Handlungsbedarf erkennen: Du analysierst die Gründe und zeigst auf, bei welchen Teammitgliedern Unterstützung oder Handlungsbedarf besteht. Reports weiterentwickeln & automatisieren: Du optimierst bestehende Auswertungen und automatisierst wiederkehrende Reports, wo es sinnvoll ist. Ad-hoc-Analysen: Du übernimmst kurzfristige Analysen für das Key Account Management. Das bringst du mit Du bist eingeschriebener Student, z. B. in BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsmathematik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Fach. Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Zahlen und gehst sicher mit MS Excel oder Google Sheets um. Plus, aber kein Muss: Erste Erfahrung mit SQL, BI-Tools wie Power BI oder Tableau oder im Controlling. Du arbeitest sorgfältig und strukturiert, auch wenn es mal schnell gehen muss. Du kommunizierst klar und traust Dich, Auffälligkeiten direkt anzusprechen, auch gegenüber Führungskräften. Du kannst 20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten, verteilt auf alle Wochentage (Mo–Fr), da das Reporting täglich anfällt. Du arbeitest vor Ort in unserem Büro in Berlin Mitte. Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch (mindestens C1), da Du täglich Auswertungen mit dem Head of KAM besprichst und Auffälligkeiten klar kommunizierst. C2 ist ein Plus. Benefits Echte Verantwortung – Du hast einen direkten Draht zum Head of Key Account Management, und Deine Analysen zählen jeden Tag. Praxiswissen für Studium und Karriere – Du sammelst Erfahrung in Controlling, KPI-Reporting und Datenanalyse. Flexible Zeiteinteilung – Innerhalb des Tages stimmst Du Deine Arbeitszeiten auf Deine Vorlesungen ab. In der Prüfungsphase finden wir gemeinsam eine Lösung. Modernes Office in Berlin Mitte – Zentral gelegen, mit bester Anbindung und freundlicher Atmosphäre. Top Equipment – Laptop, Bildschirm, Headset – alles für Deinen Erfolg. Innovative Tools – Slack, Zoom & CRM-Systeme, die Deinen Arbeitsalltag effizient machen. Events & Teambuilding – Ob Fußball, Volleyball oder After-Work: Bei uns kommt der Spaß nicht zu kurz. Snacks & Drinks – Gratis Kaffee, Getränke, Obst und individuelle REWE-Snacks auf Knopfdruck. FRIYAY-Mood – Jeden Freitag gemeinsamer Ausklang mit Pizza und Bier. Office Dogs welcome – Dein Vierbeiner ist bei uns herzlich willkommen. Klingt nach Dir? Dann bewirb Dich mit Deinem Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben brauchst Du nicht, ein paar Sätze, warum Dich die Stelle reizt, freuen uns aber. Wir freuen uns auf Dich! Pflegia ist ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit Sitz in Berlin, das auf Eigenverantwortung, transparente Kommunikation und partnerschaftliches Arbeiten setzt. Bei uns zählt nicht, woher Du kommst, sondern wohin Du gemeinsam mit uns willst.

title: Associate Analyst, Business Operations - (Fixed Term) (Labeling Operations, Consumer)
description:
**Company Description**

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

 **Job Description**

Learning nonstop. Innovation on tap. As an **Associate Analyst** you'll run the day-to-day of our labeling operations: planning capacity across concurrent projects, owning guidelines and quality standards, and working with partner teams such as Talabat and PedidosYa. The labeled data you oversee feeds the Search and Recommendation systems that serve millions of requests every day.

The Labeling Operations team sits in the Consumer Discovery organization and produces the labeled data behind Search, Recommendation and Intent Collection. Together with a team of around 14–16 interns, we set the guidelines, tooling and quality standards that keep that data consistent. We work closely with external partner teams at Talabat and PedidosYa.

At Delivery Hero, you'll shape the global consumer experience for millions of users. Your work will have a direct impact on how we attract and retain customers, creating data-driven, personalized interactions that keep them coming back. As part of our Consumer Team, you'll enhance customer satisfaction and drive global growth and profitability through innovative projects.

* Plan capacity across concurrent labeling projects and drive weekly and monthly prioritization.
* Scope and set up labeling projects end to end, maintain and evolve the guidelines, and advise stakeholders on labeling standards.
* Review work quality and process compliance, and report results to stakeholders.
* Act as the main point of contact for external partner teams such as Talabat and PedidosYa.
* Onboard new labelers and support hiring by reviewing candidate case studies and planning capacity for new joiners.
* Label data hands-on when the team needs it.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree (completed or in progress) in a related field such as Business, Finance, Accounting or Engineering.
* Fluency in spoken and written English and **Spanish.**
* Ability to work accurately with large amounts of data and documents, with strong attention to detail.
* Strong organization and communication skills, and experience working with different stakeholders.
* Experience defining guidelines or rules for large projects.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with data labeling tools.
* Experience working with Talabat or PedidosYa teams, and a good understanding of their markets.
* General knowledge of food culture and traditions.

  
**Additional Information**

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

* Make the most of our hybrid working model and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
* We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
* We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
* Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
* Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
* The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.
* Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together 10 things you should know about moving to Berlin and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
* Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers created in collaboration with our recruiters.

*Heads up: exact benefits may look a little different for intern, working student, fixed-term, and part-time roles.*

Ready to join our team? If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com.

You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.

title: Werkstudent:in Energy Operations (m/w/d)
description: Über uns Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser . In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement. Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur. Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht. VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden ( 42b EnWG). Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance: Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer, ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität. Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt. Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus. Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS. Dein Profil Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2), High-Growth Start-ups (dealerweise Operations oder Prozessoptimierung), oder im Projektmanagement in Form von Praktika gesammelt Du studierst aktuell im Bachelor oder Master in einem relevanten Bereich wie z.B. Wirtschaftsingenieurswesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder Energiewirtschaft Du denkst unternehmerisch, triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen und setzt klare Prioritäten mit Blick auf Impact, Skalierbarkeit und langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Start-ups, Energie oder Immobilien mit Du willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten Du strebst danach, die beste Version deiner selbst zu werden und suchst Umgebungen, in denen du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend Deine Aufgaben Mission der Rolle Du unterstützt unser Energy Operations Team bei der operativen Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Kundenprojekte. Dein Ziel: Projekte strukturiert voranbringen, interne Prozesse skalierbarer machen und datenbasierte Entscheidungen ermöglichen. Dabei wirst du ein tiefes Verständnis für Energieprojekte, Operations und Business-Aufbau entwickeln. Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Energieprojekten Du unterstützt bei der operativen und technischen Umsetzung laufender Kundenprojekte - von der Unterschrift bis zur erfolgreichen Realisierung Du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams und externen Partnern zusammen und hilfst, reibungslose Projektabläufe sicherzustellen Du übernimmst eigenständig Teilprojekte und sorgst für eine strukturierte Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung Unterstützung beim Aufbau & der Weiterentwicklung unseres Operating Models Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse und identifizierst Komplexität sowie Optimierungspotenziale Du hilfst dabei, Entscheidungsprozesse zu strukturieren und operativ sauber aufzusetzen Du unterstützt beim Aufbau skalierbarer Strukturen, Standards und Templates für operative Projekte Prozessoptimierung & interne Strukturen Du entwickelst interne Prozesse und Tools (z. B. in Airtable) weiter, um operative Effizienz und Skalierbarkeit zu erhöhen Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale in bestehenden Abläufen und setzt konkrete Optimierungen, z.B. mittels Automatisierungen, um Du übernimmst bereichsübergreifende Special Projects in den Bereichen Organisation, Tooling und interne Strukturen Benefits Vergütung: Kompetitives Gehalt Startdatum: so bald wie möglich Team & Benefits: Lustiges Team, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket Weitere Vorteile: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Bei uns entstehen keine endlosen Slide-Decks oder rein theoretische Modelle – wir bauen ein Unternehmen und machen tagtäglich einen großen Schritt nach vorne. Wenn du von Tag 1 an etwas Großem mitgestalten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss Bei VREY sind wir davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt uns als Unternehmen und Gesellschaft stärkt . Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, zögere nicht, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Wenn du von unserer Mission begeistert bist und glaubst, einen Beitrag leisten zu können, möchten wir von dir hören! Der beste Weg ist eine warme Intro: Kennst du jemand, der auf diese Rolle passt? Empfiehl die Person und erhalte 500€ bei erfolgreicher Einstellung. Voraussetzung: Die Person ist uns noch nicht bei uns im Prozess und wird offiziell vorgeschlagen. Auszahlung nach bestandener Probezeit. Bei mehrfacher Nennung zählt die erste eingegangene Empfehlung.

title: Praktikant / Werkstudent Cloud Transformation (w/m/d)
description: Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Consulting suchen wir dich zum 1. Juli 2026 als Praktikant / Werkstudent Cloud Transformation (w/m/d) . Das erwartet dich Beratung – Als vollwertiges Mitglied unseres Teams im Bereich Cloud unterstützt du bei der Beratung führender Unternehmen von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung. Du wirst ins Tagesgeschäft eingebunden und trägst so zum Projekterfolg bei. Projektvielfalt – Durch vielfältige Cloud Projekte lernst du unterschiedlichste Themen innerhalb einer Technologietransformation kennen. Das Leistungsspektrum umfasst u.a. Cloud Strategy & Transformation, Operating Model & Workforce, Cloud-Powered Innovation, Modernization & Migration, Industry Cloud, Cloud Data & AI, and Cloud Compliance & Security. Innovationen – Je nach Interesse kannst du dich in Bereichen wie M365, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, General AI, Cloud Engineering oder Business App Entwicklung vertiefen und aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Lösungen beitragen. Problemlösung – Gemeinsam im interdisziplinären Team und mit Berater:innen von PwC erarbeitest du nachhaltige und effiziente Lösungen im Spannungsfeld komplexer Cloud Transformationen bei unseren Kunden. Das bringst du mit Du studierst (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science oder Betriebswirtschaft mit einem Schwerpunkt auf IT oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und hast mindestens das dritte Fachsemester abgeschlossen. Du begeisterst dich für die digitale Transformation und innovative Technologien wie Cloud Computing (insb. AWS, Azure, GCP), Modern Workplaces (insb. M365, D365 und Power Platform), Data Analytics und Künstliche Intelligenz. Du bringst Kenntnisse in MS Office (insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel) mit, idealerweise auch erste Erfahrungen mit Programmiersprachen wie Python, SQL, R oder Java. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab. Du möchtest uns über einen Zeitraum von mindestens drei Monaten unterstützen. Wir suchen bevorzugt Studierende in den letzten Studiensemestern mit Interesse an langfristiger Entwicklung bei PwC. Deine Benefits Kultur – Wir möchten, dass du dich bei uns wohl fühlst. Deshalb pflegen wir eine offene und moderne Unternehmens- sowie Führungskultur, in der wir geleistete Arbeit gemeinsam anerkennen und feiern. Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten. Masterförderung – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Darüber hinaus bieten wir die Möglichkeit einer Masterförderung für Examensmaster und Spezialisierungsmaster an. KiT – Mit unserem Programm "Keep in Touch" (KiT) bleiben wir auch nach Praktikumsende mit unseren Praktikant:innen und Werkstudierenden in Kontakt und bieten dir viele Vorteile, wie z.B. exklusive Einladungen zu Seminaren und Workshops sowie umfangreiche Informationen zu den Einstiegsmöglichkeiten. Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite. Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Cloud Teams verknüpfst du Technologien und Businessperspektiven, um unsere Kunden bei allen wichtigen Fragen entlang ihrer Cloud-Transformations-Journey zu unterstützen. Mithilfe unseres umfassenden Fachwissens im Cloud-Bereich und zertifizierten Cloud-Expert:innen für Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS) und Google Cloud Platform (GCP) identifizieren wir gemeinsam mit dir im Team und mit unseren Kunden die beste Cloud-Lösung und -Strategie. Unterstütze uns dabei, die Wachstumspotenziale unserer Mandanten in der digitalen Welt zu nutzen! Kontakt Du hast Fragen zu dieser Position oder deiner Bewerbung? Melde dich gerne bei uns unter +49 69 9585-2222 .

title: Werkstudent Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) für SAP Service Transition & Automation (all genders)
description: Du möchtest die Möglichkeiten von KI in der Praxis einsetzen und aktiv zur Digitalisierung beitragen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und entwickle gemeinsam mit unseren Experten innovative Lösungen für die Übernahme und den Betrieb von SAP Managed Services.
