title: (Junior) Product Manager (m/w/d) – neues Produkt
description: Über diesen Job Wie können wir ERP-Systeme mit KI neu denken? Wie verbinden wir intelligente Automatisierung mit einer intuitiven Plattform, die Menschen die Möglichkeit gibt, ihre Prozesse selbst zu gestalten? Als (Junior) Product Manager (m/w/d) gestaltest Du genau das mit. Unser ERP-System verbindet Einkauf, Logistik und Verkauf – und ist damit die zentrale Plattform unseres Geschäfts. Gemeinsam mit unseren Teams hinterfragst Du bestehende Abläufe, identifizierst Potenziale für Automatisierung und entwickelst aus Ideen konkrete Lösungen. Dabei erkundest Du auch, wo KI echten Mehrwert schafft: Welche Aufgaben können Agenten zukünftig eigenständig übernehmen – und wie können sie Menschen unterstützen. Vom ersten Tag an treibst Du eigene Projekte voran und übernimmst echte Verantwortung – von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Was Du mitbringst? Neugier, Eigeninitiative und den Anspruch, komplexe Abläufe einfacher zu machen. Gestalte mit uns die nächste Generation unserer ERP-Plattform. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung als (Junior) Product Manager (m/w/d) bei CHECK24 Möbel GmbH in Berlin! Was Du mitbringst Einen sehr guten Studienabschluss: idealerweise mit technischer oder wirtschaftlicher Ausrichtung Analytisches und strukturiertes Denken: Du durchdringst komplexe Abläufe, stellst die richtigen Fragen und entwickelst daraus pragmatische Lösungen Produktverständnis und Nutzerfokus: Du möchtest verstehen, was unsere Teams im Alltag brauchen, und hast ein Gespür dafür, wie Software ihre Arbeit erleichtern kann Technische Neugier: Du arbeitest Dich gerne in Systeme und technische Zusammenhänge ein. Du hast Lust, die Möglichkeiten von KI und Automatisierung an konkreten Anwendungsfällen auszuprobieren Eigeninitiative und Umsetzungsstärke: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, übernimmst Verantwortung und treibst Deine Themen bis zur fertigen Lösung voran Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse Zu Deinen Aufgaben zählen Du gestaltest das digitale Herzstück unseres Geschäfts: Du entwickelst unser ERP-System weiter und sorgst dafür, dass es mit den Anforderungen an unser Möbelbusiness wächst. Du entwickelst Features mit echtem Impact: Du übersetzt Herausforderungen aus dem Tagesgeschäft in durchdachte Produktlösungen, die Arbeitsschritte vereinfachen, Fehler reduzieren und unseren Teams Zeit sparen. Du bringst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammen: Von Einkauf über Logistik bis Verkauf – Du verstehst, wie unsere Teams arbeiten und ihre Prozesse ineinandergreifen. Daraus entwickelst Du Lösungen, die über einzelne Bereiche hinaus funktionieren. Du denkst Prozesse neu und automatisierst intelligent: Du nutzt moderne Technologien sowie KI, um Prozesse einfacher, schneller und zuverlässiger zu machen. Du übernimmst Ownership: Du entwickelst Produktanforderungen, priorisierst Verbesserungen und begleitest Deine Features von der Konzeption über die Umsetzung und das Testing bis zum Go-Live. Was wir Dir bieten Top-Einstieg in die Arbeitswelt – sei von Anfang an bei der Entwicklung eines neuen Projekts zur Erweiterung der Wertschöpfungskette dabei und arbeite täglich an herausfordernden und abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben, bei denen Du von Tag eins Verantwortung übernimmst Ownership für Deine Themen – wir geben Dir viel Raum für Eigeninitiative. Bringe Deine Ideen aktiv ein und beeinflusse somit direkt den Erfolg von CHECK24! Events & Teamspirit – wir leben Teamgeist im Arbeitsalltag und darüber hinaus – sei es beim gemeinsamen Lunch, Kickern oder After-Work-Treffen – und auch unsere Erfolge feiern wir bei regelmäßigen Firmen- und Teamevents zusammen Gemeinsame Mittagessen – montags, dienstags und donnerstags gibt es für Dich einen kostenlosen Lunch Gesundheit & Fitness – Zuschuss zu externen Sportangeboten (u.a. title: Founders Associate (Enterprise Product) (all genders)
description: Your Impact This is not a traditional FA role. You work directly with our CEO and focus fully on product. autarc isgrowing into the operating system for larger energy businesses: multi-location installers, companies with 50+ employees and utilities. They need deeper ERP functionality, permissions, integrations, migrations and reporting that hold up at scale. You drive this. Your role sits between a forward deployed engineer and the interface to our five product teams. You lead the migrations of multi-million businesses to autarc and bring every insight from the field back to the right PM. You work as one team with enterprise sales and customer success, stay close to customers in shared WhatsApp groups and jump in hands-on whenever they need something. You also run sales calls with large ERP prospects yourself. Your goal: a product our customers truly love. Especially in the beginning, you are on the road every two weeks, spending several days at a time with customers across Germany to build out our ERP motion. The career path is clear: after 6 to 9 months, you move from Founders Associate to PM Enterprise. You already bring product management experience. What you get from us is the deep dive: how our product works, how we think, our strategy and our product philosophy, straight from our CEO and alongside our five PMs.Your responsibilities include: Lead migrations of multi-million businesses to autarc and own them until the deadline Write tickets and coordinate delivery across Product, Engineering, Design, Sales and CustomerSuccess Work hands-on with enterprise sales and customer success, on-site with customers every two weeks Bring field insights to all five product teams and shape the enterprise roadmap with the CEO and PMs Track the trades ERP and installer software market and sharpen how autarc positions itself to win Turn customer discovery into clear specs and decisions Build prototypes and internal tools with AI (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable or whatever works best) Own product KPIs, usage analysis and follow-through on launches What You Bring 1 to 3 years of product management experience, ideally at a startup or in B2B software You live and breathe product. You are curious and can't stop improving things Ambitious, high-drive and very sharp. You pick up complex topics fast and want to grow quickly You build things. You have vibe coded real tools or apps and can show us what you made AI-pilled: you use AI for everything and get excited by every new model and tool Strong analytical skills and comfortable with data, systems and enterprise complexity You earn trust across teams without formal authority, through what you know and what you deliver Confident in front of a room. You present to 40 to 50 people and know the product down to everydetail You love being on the road. Every other week at customers across Germany, with nights in hotels You want to work hard. We work long hours with high intensity. If work-life balance is your top priority right now, this role is not the right fit Berlin-based, 5 days a week in the office (Mitte) when you are not on the road Fluent in English and German Big plus: You know the trades (Handwerk). You have worked at or with an installer, know software fortradespeople, our market and our competitors. Nice to have: Experience with data migrations and coding skills (SQL, Python). What We Offer A clear career path: from Founders Associate to PM Enterprise after 6 to 9 months, learning our product strategy and philosophy directly from our CEO Real ownership: Drive your work from idea to impact. Low ego, high trust: No blame, open feedback, collaboration over hierarchy. Be part of the energy transition: Help bring more heat pumps and solar to homes every day. Hybrid work in Berlin-Mitte: 3 days together in our office near Weinbergspark, 2 from home. Need more flexibility? We'll find a way. Modern equipment: MacBook and 27″ monitor. Annual team retreat plus regular team events. Mobility: Dance e-bike or Deutschland-Ticket. When it gets late: Your dinner via Uber Eats and your taxi home are on us. Fitness: Urban Sports Club membership. Next steps If your application is successful, you will participate in the following: Culture fit call Build challenge: a short take-home where you prototype something real Final on-site interview with the CEO and the team About Us Heating our buildings causes around 25% of Europe's CO₂ emissions. Decarbonizing it depends on installers – and there are far too few of them to keep up with the growing demand for heat pumps. autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe: software that makes planning, designing and installing heat pumps faster and more digital. Our goal is to help plan and design 1 million heat pumps by 2030. Founded in Berlin and backed by Y Combinator (S24), we're a team of 60+ people across Sales, Tech and Operations, already serving more than 2,000 customers.

description: Scalable Capital is a leading digital investment and banking platform with a full banking licence, empowering people across Europe to shape their own finances. Scalable Broker makes it easy and affordable for clients to invest professionally in stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, and derivatives, as well as set up savings plans. Scalable Wealth, the digital wealth management service, offers clients professional investment in ETF portfolios, and is also adopted as a white-label solution by banks and other B2B partners. The company’s offerings are rounded off by attractive interest rates, loans, and private equity. With the European Investor Exchange, Scalable Capital offers an exchange specifically for retail investors. Over one million clients have already entrusted more than €30 billion to the platform. Founded in 2014, Scalable Capital now employs over 700 people across Munich, Berlin, Vienna, Milan, and London. Together with the founding and management team, including Erik Podzuweit and Florian Prucker, they are working on a new generation of financial services. Visit our finance blog or check out our Social Media channels to find out what our Expert Teams have to say. Our Company Values guide us every day in how we work and collaborate. To learn more about them, you can find our values here (English). Job Description We are expanding our Product organization and are looking for an impact-driven (Associate) Product Manager (m/f/x) to join our Onboarding and Client Data domain. In this role, you will help shape the foundations of the client’s relationship with Scalable. This includes seamless onboarding, keeping important client information up to date, managing statuses and blocks, and reliably handling key lifecycle events. title: Junior Product Owner (m/w/d) – Certificate Business
description: Zertificon Solutions – Software manufacturer since 2004. We are IT security specialists: Our products encrypt business communications. More than 25% of Germany's 100 largest companies by revenue, along with hundreds of medium-sized businesses across various industries, already rely on our Z1 encryption solutions. We have ambitious plans and continue to grow steadily. Almost 140 employees are already working at our Berlin-Neukölln office. Join our professional, highly qualified team: Take on new challenges, share your knowledge, keep learning, and discover your potential! Your tasks As a Junior Product Owner , you will contribute to the further development of our solutions for managing digital certificates – a key foundation for secure and encrypted business communication. Working closely with our Head of Product Certificate Business , you will help shape software components and services for managing and searching digital certificates, integrating external Certificate Authorities (CAs), and automating certificate-related processes. You independently develop solution concepts for new and existing features, taking into account customer needs, technical feasibility, and business objectives. You collaborate with our UI/UX Designer to create user-friendly solutions and, when needed, develop smaller mockups yourself. You translate agreed solution concepts into actionable epics, tasks, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria for your development team. You take ownership of maintaining and preparing your development team's product backlog and prioritize requirements in coordination with the Head of Product. You plan and coordinate software releases, keeping track of timelines, dependencies, and potential risks. As the main point of contact for your development team, you clarify functional questions and coordinate collaboration with Product Management, Support, and other stakeholders. You analyze market trends and the competitive landscape, using your insights to identify opportunities for improving our products. Your profile At least one year of hands-on experience in Product Ownership, Requirements Engineering, or a comparable role, ideally in a B2B software environment. Basic knowledge of software development and agile methodologies. Ability to structure complex topics and translate them into clear, actionable requirements for developers. Good technical understanding and an interest in software architectures, interfaces, and system integrations. Interest in IT security, digital certificates, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) – prior knowledge in these areas is an advantage but not a requirement. Analytical, structured, and detail-oriented approach to work, combined with a strong willingness to learn. Ability to work independently, reliability, and enjoyment of collaborating with different teams. Excellent English skills (at least C1 level) and good German skills (at least B2 level). We offer Flexible hours and home office options Mobility: free Germany-wide public transport ticket, bike leasing, or parking Subsidies for meals (e.g., delivery services) and home office internet Urban Sports Club membership for flexible fitness and wellness Office perks: rooftop terraces & green courtyard, organic fruit and drinks, personal packages accepted at the office Get-togethers: monthly Pizza Friday, regular team events, big summer party Responsible leadership: structured onboarding, regular feedback, clear goals Innovative without startup risk: profitable for 20+ years, self-funded innovation with strong global potential International team: 120+ colleagues from 30+ countries, open and collaborative culture If that resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you. title: Founders Associate (Enterprise Product)
description: Your Impact This is not a traditional FA role. You work directly with our CEO and focus fully on product. autarc isgrowing into the operating system for larger energy businesses: multi-location installers, companies with 50+ employees and utilities. They need deeper ERP functionality, permissions, integrations, migrations and reporting that hold up at scale. You drive this. Your role sits between a forward deployed engineer and the interface to our five product teams. You lead the migrations of multi-million businesses to autarc and bring every insight from the field back to the right PM. You work as one team with enterprise sales and customer success, stay close to customers in shared WhatsApp groups and jump in hands-on whenever they need something. You also run sales calls with large ERP prospects yourself. Your goal: a product our customers truly love. Especially in the beginning, you are on the road every two weeks, spending several days at a time with customers across Germany to build out our ERP motion. The career path is clear: after 6 to 9 months, you move from Founders Associate to PM Enterprise. You already bring product management experience. What you get from us is the deep dive: how our product works, how we think, our strategy and our product philosophy, straight from our CEO and alongside our five PMs.Your responsibilities include: Lead migrations of multi-million businesses to autarc and own them until the deadline Write tickets and coordinate delivery across Product, Engineering, Design, Sales and CustomerSuccess Work hands-on with enterprise sales and customer success, on-site with customers every two weeks Bring field insights to all five product teams and shape the enterprise roadmap with the CEO and PMs Track the trades ERP and installer software market and sharpen how autarc positions itself to win Turn customer discovery into clear specs and decisions Build prototypes and internal tools with AI (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable or whatever works best) Own product KPIs, usage analysis and follow-through on launches What You Bring 1 to 3 years of product management experience, ideally at a startup or in B2B software You live and breathe product. You are curious and can't stop improving things Ambitious, high-drive and very sharp. You pick up complex topics fast and want to grow quickly You build things. You have vibe coded real tools or apps and can show us what you made AI-pilled: you use AI for everything and get excited by every new model and tool Strong analytical skills and comfortable with data, systems and enterprise complexity You earn trust across teams without formal authority, through what you know and what you deliver Confident in front of a room. You present to 40 to 50 people and know the product down to everydetail You love being on the road. Every other week at customers across Germany, with nights in hotels You want to work hard. We work long hours with high intensity. If work-life balance is your top priority right now, this role is not the right fit Berlin-based, 5 days a week in the office (Mitte) when you are not on the road Fluent in English and German Big plus: You know the trades (Handwerk). You have worked at or with an installer, know software fortradespeople, our market and our competitors. Nice to have: Experience with data migrations and coding skills (SQL, Python). What We Offer A clear career path: from Founders Associate to PM Enterprise after 6 to 9 months, learning our product strategy and philosophy directly from our CEO Real ownership: Drive your work from idea to impact. Low ego, high trust: No blame, open feedback, collaboration over hierarchy. Be part of the energy transition: Help bring more heat pumps and solar to homes every day. Hybrid work in Berlin-Mitte: 3 days together in our office near Weinbergspark, 2 from home. Need more flexibility? We'll find a way. Modern equipment: MacBook and 27″ monitor. Annual team retreat plus regular team events. Mobility: Dance e-bike or Deutschland-Ticket. When it gets late: Your dinner via Uber Eats and your taxi home are on us. Fitness: Urban Sports Club membership. Next steps If your application is successful, you will participate in the following: Culture fit call Build challenge: a short take-home where you prototype something real Final on-site interview with the CEO and the team About Us Heating our buildings causes around 25% of Europe's CO₂ emissions. Decarbonizing it depends on installers – and there are far too few of them to keep up with the growing demand for heat pumps. autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe: software that makes planning, designing and installing heat pumps faster and more digital. Our goal is to help plan and design 1 million heat pumps by 2030. Founded in Berlin and backed by Y Combinator (S24), we're a team of 60+ people across Sales, Tech and Operations, already serving more than 2,000 customers.

title: Trainee im Junior Expert Programme – Backoffice Systems & Process Design (w/m/d)
description: Wir sind ein moderner Arbeitgeber mit attraktiven Arbeitsplätzen, zahlreichen Sozialleistungen, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Vielem mehr. Du hast Dein Studium fast geschafft und jetzt kommt der nächste Schritt: Von den Besten lernen, Verantwortung übernehmen und in unterschiedlichen Teams spannende Aufgaben meistern – im Junior Expert Programme der ING startest Du mit einem unbefristeten Vertrag in Deine Karriere. Wenn Du kurz vor Deinem Abschluss stehst und **zum 1. Januar, 1. April oder zum 1. Oktober 2027** loslegen kannst, werde Junior Expert bei der ING. In unserem COO-Bereich kommen Banking-Prozesse, Daten, künstliche Intelligenz und agile Produktentwicklung zusammen: Hier entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Teams die Systeme, Prozesse und digitalen Lösungen weiter, die Banking für 10 Millionen Kund\*innen einfach, schnell und zuverlässig machen. Deinen Weg bestimmst Du dabei aktiv mit: Über zwölf Monate durchläufst Du einen individuellen Rotationsplan, lernst verschiedene Aufgaben rund um automatisiertes Prozessdesign, digitale Kundeninteraktionen sowie AI kennen und findest heraus, welche Themen Dich fachlich und persönlich weiterbringen. An der Schnittstelle von Business, Technologie und Customer Experience stellst Du Dich Problemen, analysierst Anforderungen, entwickelst Lösungen und setzt diese um. Dabei bist Du nicht nur Beobachter\*in, sondern übernimmst früh selbst Verantwortung. Mit Blick auf die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette erkennst Du komplexe Zusammenhänge im Privat- und Business-Banking, identifizierst Automatisierungspotenziale und entwickelst konkrete, digitale Lösungsansätze für unsere Service- und Operations-Prozesse. Du bringst innovative Verbesserungen voran, indem Du fachliche Herausforderungen in technische Konzepte übersetzt, gemeinsam mit unseren Teams Prototypen entwickelst und neue AI-Lösungen sowie intelligente Assistenten auf Herz und Nieren testest. Wir trauen Dir viel zu und geben Dir Raum, Deine Ideen einzubringen und sichtbar etwas zu bewegen. Dabei bist Du nicht allein: Im Netzwerk der Graduates tauschst Du Dich aus, teilst Erfahrungen und knüpfst wertvolle Kontakte. Zusätzlich steht Dir im fachspezifischen Buddy-Programm eine erfahrene Mentorin oder ein erfahrener Mentor zur Seite. Klingt nach Deinem nächsten Schritt? Dann bring Deine Stärken ein und entwickle mit uns Lösungen, die unsere Kund*innen und unseren COO-Bereich voranbringen. title: (Junior) Data & AI Analyst (m/w/d)
description: Wer sind wir? The Pioneer ist ein digitales Medienunternehmen neuen Typs im Herzen von Berlin. Im Fokus steht innovativer und unabhängiger Journalismus rund um Wirtschaft und Politik – immer aktuell, immer relevant. Neben Gründer & Herausgeber Gabor Steingart gehören zu unseren Hosts u.a. Ex-Vizekanzler Sigmar Gabriel und Bestsellerautorin Juli Zeh. Mit dem ersten Medienschiff der Welt haben wir ein schwimmendes Büro geschaffen, das im Regierungsviertel Berlins unterwegs ist – immer am Puls der aktuellen Geschehnisse. Was Du bei uns machst Als (Junior) Data & AI Analyst machst du Daten verständlich und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns neue KI-Datenprodukte. Deine Analysen helfen Redaktion, Growth & Product, Marketing und Geschäftsleitung, fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du den Pioneer AI Analyst weiter: einen KI-Assistenten, der unseren Teams hilft, Daten zu analysieren, Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. Muster erkennen. Du analysierst die Nutzung unserer Web- und App-Angebote, die Performance unserer Inhalte und die Abo-Entwicklung. Du erkennst Trends, bewertest Optimierungspotenziale und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Orientierung geben. Du ordnest Analyseergebnisse ein, erklärst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich und präsentierst den Teams fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen. Ideen in die Praxis bringen. Mit Redaktion, Marketing und Produkt setzt du Daten- und KI-Anwendungen von der Idee bis zum Rollout um. Du entwickelst Skills und Automatisierungen mit KI-Assistenten oder n8n. Workshops und Anleitungen helfen den Teams, die Anwendungen eigenständig zu nutzen. Eine gemeinsame Datensprache schaffen. Du definierst einheitliche Kennzahlen, entwickelst Self-Service-Dashboards und unterstützt die Qualitätssicherung beim Tracking mit Google Analytics. Was Du mitbringst Du stehst kurz vor oder nach deinem Studienabschluss in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Statistik, Data Science, BWL mit Datenschwerpunkt oder einem vergleichbaren quantitativen Fach. Du bringst erste Praxiserfahrung mit – aus Beruf, Werkstudentenjob, Praktikum, Abschlussarbeit oder eigenen Projekten. Du kannst SQL schreiben und möchtest deine Kenntnisse vertiefen. Python-Kenntnisse sind ein Plus. Du nutzt KI-Assistenten und Coding-Tools für Analysen, Programmierung oder Recherche und probierst Neues aus. Du erklärst Zahlen verständlich und präsentierst Ergebnisse deinen Stakeholdern. Du erschließt dir neue Themen selbstständig und testest Ideen mit Prototypen. Erfahrungen mit BI-Tools wie QuickSight, Power BI oder Tableau sowie mit Google Analytics oder APIs sind willkommen. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Warum genau wir? Wir setzen auf Initiative. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Themen, die dir wichtig sind, und treibst sie selbst voran. In einer Phase, in der The Pioneer stetig wächst, gestaltest du so aktiv mit, wie unabhängiger Journalismus in Deutschland aussieht. Ein Arbeitsumfeld, das es sonst nicht gibt: Du arbeitest an Bord unserer Medienschiffe mit Blick auf die Spree. Für den Alltag steht dir zusätzlich unser Büro im schönen Charlottenburg offen. Du bekommst direkten Zugang zu unseren Live-Formaten und Events und erlebst Gäste aus Politik und Wirtschaft live und hautnah vor Ort. Voller Einsatz braucht volle Batterien. Mit Urban Sports Club sorgen wir dafür, dass du auch außerhalb der Arbeit in Bewegung bleibst und deinen persönlichen Ausgleich findest. Was auch immer du bei uns bewegst, tust du mit einer sicheren Basis aus unbefristeter Anstellung, einer fairen Vergütung und 30 Tagen Urlaub im Jahr. Über uns Das Nachrichtenportal The Pioneer bildet seit Mai 2020 die gemeinsame Bühne für alle journalistischen Publikationen des Medienunternehmens Media Pioneer Publishing AG. Ausgezeichnet als “Startup of the Year” (European Publishing Awards 2020) gelten wir als eines der spannendsten Medienprojekte in Europa. Unser bekanntestes Format “The Pioneer Morning Briefing” erreicht als Newsletter und Podcast jeden Morgen bis zu 1 Mio. Menschen und ist damit “Deutschlands Morning Briefing No. 1” Neben Gründer & Herausgeber Gabor Steingart gehören zu unseren Hosts u.a. Ex-Vizekanzler Sigmar Gabriel und die Journalistinnen Chelsea Spieker und Alev Do ğ an. Viele weitere Formate sind in Planung. Als schwimmender Newsroom, Produktionsort und Bühne für Live-Journalismus dient unserer Crew das erste Medienschiff der Welt, The Pioneer One, das täglich auf der Spree oder in ganz Deutschland unterwegs ist. Unsere Mission heißt Unabhängigkeit: der Politik- und Wirtschaftsjournalismus von The Pioneer ist 100% werbefrei.

description: Die e.distherm Energielösungen GmbH , ein 100%iges Tochterunternehmen der E.DIS AG und Teil der E.ON-Gruppe, ist darauf spezialisiert, individuelle, nachhaltige und klimaschonende Energielösungen für die Wohnungswirtschaft, für Kommunen sowie für Gewerbe- und Industriebetriebe zu entwickeln und zu betreiben. Dazu zählen unter anderem der Hauptstadtflughafen BER sowie namhafte Automobilhersteller und -zulieferer im Industriepark in Ludwigsfelde. Eine Aufgabe, die herausfordert Du begleitest die Migration von Stammdaten aus dem bestehenden Datenbanksystem in das neue Microsoft Dynamics Field Service System. Gemeinsam mit dem Technischen Betrieb und dem Digitalisierungsteam entwickelst du Auswertungen und Tools, um die Qualität, Vollständigkeit und Konsistenz der migrierten Daten zu prüfen. Du bereitest Analysen und Abstimmungstermine eigenverantwortlich sowie im Team vor, dokumentierst Ergebnisse und verfolgst vereinbarte Maßnahmen nach. Du unterstützt bei der Planung, Organisation und Umsetzung der Stammdatenübertragung und arbeitest dabei eng mit dem Betriebs- und Digitalisierungsteam zusammen. Gemeinsam mit dem Digitalisierungsteam entwickelst du das Microsoft Dynamics Field Service System kontinuierlich weiter, nimmst Anforderungen aus dem operativen Betrieb auf und wirkst bei der Einführung neuer Funktionen mit. Du unterstützt das Betriebsteam beim Monitoring technischer Anlagen sowie bei der Pflege und Auswertung von Störungs- und Betriebsdaten. Dabei erhältst du spannende Einblicke in die Digitalisierung technischer Prozesse und die Weiterentwicklung moderner Service- und Datenmanagementsysteme. Ein Umfeld, das begeistert Du studierst aktuell Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informationstechnik oder einen vergleichbaren technischen Studiengang. Auch wenn dein Schwerpunkt nicht direkt in der Informatik liegt, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, wenn du eine ausgeprägte IT-Affinität mitbringst. Idealerweise hast du bis zum Abschluss deines Studiums noch mindestens vier Semester vor dir und möchtest uns langfristig in einem spannenden Migrationsprojekt unterstützen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und bringst gerne eigene Ideen ein. Du hast Freude daran, gemeinsam mit anderen Lösungen zu entwickeln und Themen voranzutreiben. Erste Berührungspunkte mit Datenbanken, Datenstrukturen oder der Analyse von Datenqualität sind von Vorteil. Erfahrungen mit Microsoft Dynamics sind wünschenswert, aber kein Muss. Du verfügst über ein gutes technisches Grundverständnis und interessierst dich für digitale Prozesse und Systeme. Du kommunizierst sicher in deutscher Sprache (mindestens C2-Niveau oder muttersprachliche Kenntnisse). Die regelmäßige Zusammenarbeit vor Ort in Schönefeld ist für dich gut mit deinem Studienalltag vereinbar. Gleichzeitig profitierst du von der Möglichkeit, teilweise mobil zu arbeiten. Ein Umfeld, das begeistert Eine nachweislich hohe Mitarbeiterzufriedenheit: Zertifizierter Top Arbeitgeber seit 2022 (Kununu Score 4,3/5 Sterne & 97% Mitarbeiterweiterempfehlung). Eine Aufgabe voller Spannung, bei der wir gemeinsam an intelligenten Energienetzen und innovativen Energielösungen arbeiten. Einen flexiblen Anschluss für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance, z. B. durch flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home Office. Ein elektrisierendes Angebot an Fortbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten wie z. B. Seminare, Workshops und Talentprogramme. Eine sichere Versorgung mit einer attraktiven Vergütung sowie vielen Zusatzleistungen, u. a. Gesundheitsangebote und betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Ein starkes Netzwerk, denn als Teil des E.ON Konzerns fördern wir die Zusammenarbeit über Unternehmensgrenzen hinweg und bieten vielfältige Perspektivwechsel. Werde Teil unseres Netzwerks! Die Integration von Menschen mit Behinderung entspricht unserem Selbstverständnis und wir begrüßen daher deren Bewerbung. title: Startup Community Manager (f/m/d)
description:
#### **Your mission**

At MotionLab.Berlin, startups are our passion and our driving force—their success is our success. As our Startup Community Manager, you ensure our founders have everything they need to build better products and find capital more easily.

The Startup Community Manager turns this promise into a working service for every startup in our ecosystem. You know what each startup needs next and connect it to the right partner, expert, program or investor at the right time: you are the spider in the web of our ecosystem, not a mentor. The role is responsible for the startup accounts of MotionLab.Berlin, from account onboarding to alumni status, and represents our ecosystem in the Berlin and German deep tech network.

  
What You Own

### **Startup Community & Account Management**

* **Lifecycle Management:** Lead end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes for startups entering and exiting the MotionLab.Berlin ecosystem.
* **Founder Support:** Maintain a close pulse on startup needs and stage-specific challenges to understand their evolving needs, facilitating meaningful connections and introductions that accelerate their growth.
* **Community Events & Knowledge Sharing:** Ideate, plan, and execute community events and masterclasses (e.g., DeepTech Nexus, Investor Dinners, Fireside Chats, and specialized "How-To" sessions).
* **Internal Synergy:** Collaborate closely with the Front Desk and Community teams to stay aligned on founder needs, emerging trends, and daily space dynamics.
* **New Support Offers:** Turn needs that several startups share into new formats, partnerships or services.

### **Startup Program Execution**

* **DeepTech Mentoring Program:** Lead the mentoring track for DeepTech Award winners, managing their onboarding and periodic progress check-ins.
* **EIT DRIVE Berlin:** Own our EIT Urban Mobility project as Ecosystem Agent for Germany: source and assess urban mobility startups, prepare investment recommendations, deliver the program events and write all deliverable and KPI reports, including budget responsibility.
* **Program Logistics:** Support all MotionLab.Berlin programs by sourcing, organizing, and coordinating workshops, speakers, and domain experts.

### **External Ecosystem & Network Building**

* **Active Networking:** Build and grow a network of other hubs, initiatives and players; participate in events (min. 2 per month) and conferences to strengthen connections and represent the MotionLab.Berlin offer
* **DeepTech Landscape Mapping:** Actively track and map the Berlin DeepTech and hardware startup landscape to identify key actors and growth-stage companies.
* **Pipeline & Opportunity Identification:** Leverage market insights to identify startups for integration into our programs, as well as inspiring founders and experts for upcoming events.
* **Partner & Expert Network:** Build and maintain our pool of experts, mentors and investors and embed our partners into startup formats and introductions, so that they see real value from their partnership.

#### **Your profile**

**Non-Negotiable**

* **3+ years experience in** **Community or Account Management:** hands-on experience in account management, startup incubation/acceleration, community management, or ecosystem building.
* **Program & Event Ownership:** Demonstrated track record of conceptualizing and successfully executing high-impact programs or events.
* **Startup Ecosystem Knowledge:** Solid understanding of the German and Berlin startup scene—especially around hardware, deep-tech, and emerging technologies.

**Bonus Points If You Have:**

* **Deep-Tech & Hardware Knowledge:** Understanding of hardware startup operations, prototyping phases, and hardware-specific funding models.
* **Ecosystem Connections:** A strong network across founders, investors, and key players in the Berlin/German startup community.
* **Public Grant & Program Exposure:** Hands-on experience working with public frameworks like EIT or municipal/state innovation awards.

**Your Mindset & Skills**

* **Proactive Founder Advocate:** Excellent interpersonal skills with an empathetic, solutions-oriented approach to supporting founders through their scaling challenges.
* **High Operational Drive:** Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple program streams and community initiatives simultaneously.
* **Networker:** A natural curiosity for mapping market dynamics, identifying high-potential startups, and spotting key trends across the ecosystem.
* **Communication & Languages:** Fluent in English with strong written and verbal skills (German fluency is highly advantageous given local stakeholder and public program coordination).

#### **Why us?**

* **Be the person every founder knows:** You work with the startups of Germany’s official Deep Tech Hub every day, in our MakerGarages, Offices and Community, and you see directly what your introductions change for them.
* **Build, don’t just run:** You won’t inherit a finished playbook. You will write it: how we onboard startups, how we match them with partners, experts and investors, and which new formats our ecosystem needs.
* **Own real projects:** You lead EIT DRIVE Berlin and the Deep Tech Mentoring program end to end, with your own budget, partners and results.
* **A network that opens doors:** 110+ companies on campus, corporate partners, investors and the de:hub network. With ringberlin and its 17,000 m², the ecosystem you build now will grow with you.
* **Short decision paths, high visibility:** You work closely with leadership, and your output directly shapes the success of our startups and corporate partners.
* **A culture that is honest, learning-oriented, and community-driven:** We celebrate wins, discuss failures openly, and treat feedback as a tool.
* **Transparency:** We do not pay top corporate-level salaries. If maximum cash is your primary driver, this is probably not the right move. If you are motivated by ownership, impact and the chance to shape how hardtech startups grow in Berlin, this is a rare opportunity

#### **About us**

MotionLab.Berlin is Germany's premier Innovation Hub & Makerspace, an ecosystem for Hardtech, art, creativity, and entrepreneurship. On 5,500 sqm in Berlin-Alt-Treptow we run eight specialist labs, private offices, MakerGarages and event spaces for more than 110 deep tech companies. MotionLab.Berlin is the operating and founding partner of Berlin's official Deep Tech Hub, certified within Germany's national de:hub initiative.  
Three programs cover the full journey: the Tech Talent Program puts students on real industry challenges, the Hardtech Innovation Accelerator takes early-stage founders from idea to product without taking equity, and Deep Tech in Motion opens international markets. Next up: ringberlin, our second campus in Berlin-Tempelhof with 17,000 sqm.  
Working at MotionLab.Berlin means building the place where hardware gets built. You work next to the founders you support, in a hall with a double-decker bus, a CNC lab and a Demo Day stage. Small team, short decisions, real responsibility from day one. English is our working language.  
Questions about a role? Write to hiring@motionlab.berlin, we read every mail. Let's build.

title: City Manager
description:
Key Objectives of the Role

Yugo is the trusted name for student housing, globally. Every day we connect young people to opportunities and students to amazing spaces. Here at Yugo, we like to do things differently. It's about people, planet, and passion.

Our City Managers are in charge of our spaces within an assigned city location. This position has both an operational and strategic focus, they are #Futureshapers who want to positively influence and shape the lives of others students and Yugoers. They are responsible of the smooth running of our spaces and they oversee the day-to-day management as well as setting the future direction for the area.

Working closely with Assistant Residence Managers, the City Manager will ensure their assigned portfolio are safe and secure spaces that meet the established operational, financial and business-related targets. They will take overall responsibility for multiple assets in championing and executing strategies relating to property management operations, implementing agreed policies, and procedures and practices, whilst also actively driving improvement and operational excellence.

It’s a big job! Ensuring that our services are consistent and that we provide the best experience for students to live their best lives and financial performance for our investors.

 **Requirements**

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Asset Management**

a. Manage and monitor appropriate health and safety compliance across the area, promoting a risk-free environment; drive a positive health and safety culture.

b. Oversee and support regulatory and compliance issues, as well as managing the financial performance of all spaces within the area.

c. Lead continuous improvement and provide value added initiatives across the area.

d. Take responsibility for asset mobilisation of any new residences in the location- to include the set-up of operational costings, people structures, standard operating procedures, recruitment of the teams and coordinating a meaningful onboarding experience in readiness of practical completion.

e. Provide and manage an escalation matrix in the event of an emergency, liaising with any press and responding to investors as appropriate.

f. Work with a wider operations team to drive consistent performance across the portfolio.

g. Use your upbeat, **open** minded and outgoing personality to lead, mentor and guide the team to ensure that the student space is running smoothly and new ideas are being welcomed.

h. Be Real. Take pride in what you do and own it. Ensuring high standards of all spaces under your management.

2. **Deliver on Income Targets**

a. Take a commercial approach to managing the residences whilst actively seeking ways to maximise revenue, including summer occupancy and alternative use strategy, and to identify ways to drive greater efficiency and reduce the cost per bed.

b. Be accountable for the delivery of all KPIs of the spaces under your responsibility, including the delivery of income targets in accordance with sales process and standards; regularly monitor performance and take action where necessary.

c. Lead on the annual budget setting process and the budget reforecast for the residences in conjunction with the Assistant Residence Managers.

d. Approve invoices from vendors, contractors and service providers for payment, escalating any issues to the finance team as appropriate.

e. Maintain and develop relationships with key players at the local universities, education organizations and any other key stakeholders–in order to build stronger referral networks and potentially secure future business.

f. Work alongside the Sales and Marketing team to develop and execute strategies to enhance sales opportunities and performance within the area, ensuring that all properties have an occupancy level in line with the business plan, taking action where necessary including escalating any issues to the Operations Manager.

**Key Performance Indicators – Revenue**

* NOI target Monthly, YTD, against budget for each space
* GOI target Monthly, YTD, against budget for each space
* Debt target Monthly, YTD, against budget for each space

**3. Student Experience**

a. Ensure that our students live their best life, so that we exceed their expectations and they re-book or refer us to others.

b. Act as an inspirational lead to the team by exceeding expectations for our residents; oversee the delivery of outstanding customer service by others

c. Inspire the team to initiate and lead on resident involvement and social events.

d. Be proactive in striving for continuous improvement to our service offering, ensuring positive feedback from our residents, strong social media presence, and minimal complaints.

e. Be True. Acting responsible towards others and the planet. Making sure to deliver on our three Pillars to ensure our students live their best life. YugoEco, YuPro and YuGrow..

**4. Our Team of Yugoers**

a. Lead and inspire the operational teams to perform across the spaces of your responsibility. Be Bold. Ensuring that boundaries are there to be challenged and encourage a bias for action attitude across the teams.

b. To be both part of the Senior Operations team and a support to local residence-based teams.

c. Line manages and act as a coach to the General and Residence Managers within the area, including conducting regular one-to-one’s, appraisals, creating development plans and any other forms of people management that are required.

d. Act as a role model by consistently demonstrating the GSA values.

e. Liaise with student groups and University partners in order to drive the business forward and to manage and maintain productive ongoing relationships.

f. Work closely with any support function as required to drive collaborative working, operational performance and to maximise revenue.

g. Build strong relationships with key support functions including Sales, Marketing, Data and Analytics, Systems, HR and Finance.

Key Performance Indicators – People

* Attrition

* + HRIS – monthly across Spaces
* Leavers within 90 days across spaces as per target
* Engagement

* Participation rate goal in annual engagement survey
* Survey Engagement score from annual survey
* Performance Reviews Completion – annually as per target

**5. What else?**

This job description serves as a guideline; this list of responsibilities is not intended to be exhaustive and other requests commensurate with the role may be made of you from time-to-time. This role also requires a degree of flexibility in terms of days and hours worked. There may be occasional weekend and evening work, particularly during the busy summer months.

Key Skills & Capabilities

* **Excellent communicator.** Articulates and reinforce our brand story, values and behaviors with your teams. With great skills in both written and oral English & Spanish.
* **Passion**– Shows interest in, anticipates, and responds timely to stakeholder needs. Strives to consistently meet service standards.
* **Managing resources** – Plans, coordinates and manages internal and external resources to accomplish role responsibilities and/or assigned tasks.
* **Interpersonal skills**–Gives timely feedback and provides coaching to the teams to help them develop and grow to their maximum potential. Understands and recognizes the value of other points of view and ways of doing things.
* **Administrative Skills** – Computer literate with strong application of Microsoft programs Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

Demonstrable knowledge and experience in producing sound technical reports. Understands and recognises the value of other points of view and ways of doing things.

Experience and Knowledge

**Essential:**

a. Relevant experience managing teams (e.g. hospitality, residence-based, student accommodation)

b. Proven financial responsibility including managing forecasts, budgets and P&Ls.

c. Experience delivering projects on time and to a high standard.

d. Experience developing a continuous improvement culture and to have an impact on the way things are done.

e. Resilience and adaptability, as well as a great cultural diversity awareness.

f. Qualification and/or willingness to undertake training for Carbon Literacy.

**Desirable:**

a. Experience in other markets and areas

b. Relevant Business or Hospitality degree

c. Competency in other languages

d. Experience of working with diversity and in different markets

title: AI Platform Engineer - Edgy device (m/f/d)
description:
**AI Platform Engineer - Edgy device**

Our AI analyses real production lines through cameras and edge devices in customer factories. We’re looking for an **AI Platform Engineer** who understands how systems work underneath, from the OS and network up to the cloud, and who will own the software on our growing device fleet and the infrastructure that runs it.

**What you'll do**

* Own the software on our edge fleet once a device is online: components, configuration, and OS, kernel and GPU driver updates.
* Build the release path to devices: CI/CD, canary, staged rollouts and rollback over unreliable factory networks.
* Run fleet monitoring and alerting that catches failing devices and cameras before customers notice; decide whether a fault is software or hardware.
* Debug hard problems across the stack (processes, memory, disk, network, GPU) and fix root causes, not symptoms.
* Own our cloud infrastructure in Terraform, including the central systems we use to manage the edge fleet (AWS).
* Work closely with our Installations team, who set up devices and networks on site.

**You are**

* 8-10 years in platform, infrastructure, SRE or systems roles.
* Strong OS fundamentals: processes, memory, file systems, boot, services. You can debug a Linux machine from the shell.
* Solid networking: TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VPN, firewalls.
* Experienced with automation and infrastructure as code (Terraform a must, Ansible or similar) and CI/CD. Comfortable with containers and AWS.
* Methodical and curious: you want to know why something broke, not just make it work again.

**Nice to have**

* Have run a fleet of remote, on-prem or edge machines (IoT, retail, telecom).
* AWS IoT Greengrass or similar device management.
* NVIDIA GPUs or Jetson: drivers, CUDA.
* Unattended installs or OS images (PXE, cloud-init, ...).
* Kubernetes in production.
* Video, camera or ML inference workloads.

**Why this role matters**

You'll keep our systems running smoothly and help the team ship with confidence. And if you're curious about ML, you'll get real exposure to production AI systems.

#LI-SP1 #LI-Hybrid

**What we offer**

Employee Share Options Program for all permanent employees\*

An increasing benefits list: currently includes Urban Sports club and quarterly team retreats.

Be on the forefront in defining what artificial intelligence means in manufacturing

Gain hands-on experience in working in an AI-first software company

Supportive and inclusive culture that values diversity and promotes the advancement of underrepresented groups within the company

Collaborate with a diverse (currently more than 10 nationalities) and talented team, working on cutting-edge projects with real-world impact

Network with professionals and leaders in the field, opening doors to potential future career opportunities

We have a very flat hierarchy, open 360° feedback, and flexible working hours

Ethics: We are committed to developing ethical AI software  
  
**Don't meet all the requirements?**

*Almetra is committed to creating a workplace that is diverse, fair, and inclusive. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds, even if they do not meet every qualification, to submit their application. We firmly believe that having a team with diverse perspectives only strengthens our company and drives innovation. Our commitment also extends to providing an accessible environment for everyone, including those with disabilities. Please let us know if you require any accommodations during the application process or while working with us, and we will do our best to support you.*

* *Only full-time, permanent roles are eligible for stock options. Part-time roles, contract roles, work-student, internships and freelance roles are not eligible for stock options.*

title: Hands-on Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
description:
**Location**: 100% remote (EMEA)

**Classification**: Full-time

**Pay Range**: 82.000€ to 140.000€ - determined by several factors, including location

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

### **What you’ll work on****:**

We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers.

### **What’s unique about management at Miaplaza:**

Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice:

* You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important.
* We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer.
* We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you.
* One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports' work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output.
* Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students.

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader, of which:
  + 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead
* 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering, of which:
* 3+ years running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE preferred)
* 3+ years of experience with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code. GCP is our primary cloud and we expect senior-level knowledge of IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, CloudSQL and Secret Manager
* 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level.
* Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operations
* Experience with GitOps (FluxCD or ArgoCD)
* Experience working directly with engineering teams and other managers as your customers on scoping and prioritization
* Experience leading incident response, including running postmortems

### **What makes you stand out:**

Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

Experience with consumer platforms at scale

Experience building in regulated environments

Experience operating self-hosted observability stacks (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry)

Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling

Experience supporting .NET/C# application deployments

Experience with database operations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ)

Experience with Istio or other service meshes

### **Responsibilities**

* Work with your team to design, build, and operate the infrastructure the rest of engineering depends on: clusters, pipelines, databases, edge, and observability
* Your customers are the other engineering teams. Work with the other Engineering Managers and product development leadership to scope and prioritize platform work
* Set the quality bar for your team. Lead by example.
* Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean infrastructure-as-code, soft skills, best practices, etc
* Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

### **Our hiring process**

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

* **Application and CV Review** - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update.
* **Initial Technical Screen** (20 minutes) - A quick screening call to answer some administrative questions and confirm your basic technical knowledge. You'll be asked some administrative questions and 7 short technical questions related to the role.
* **Behavioral Interview** (1 hour) - Meet with a member of our HR team to discuss your experience and share your approach throughout your career so far.
* **1st Technical Interview** (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team to answer focused technical questions tailored to our work.
* **Scenario-based Technical Interview** (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team and the team's engineering manager to work through two hypothetical DevOps scenarios and how you would tackle them.
* **Leadership Interview** (1 hour) - With our head of engineering and executive leadership.
* **Reference check** - We'll reach out to the 3 references you provided, at least one being a former or current manager and any former or current direct reports.
* **Offer & background check** - Once you sign your offer, we'll run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

### **Compensation and setup**

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area.

Miaplaza is a growing, self-funded EdTech company. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

title: Intern Strategic Projects (w/m/d)
description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest strategische Projekte im Bereich Baubarkeit von der ersten Analyse bis zur Umsetzung. Du analysierst unseren Sales- und Operations-Funnel und identifizierst, an welchen Stellen und aus welchen Gründen wir bei Kund:innen nicht bauen können. Du bewertest den Impact unterschiedlicher Initiativen, erstellst Business Cases und leitest daraus Prioritäten ab. Du identifizierst innovative Bautechnologien und Prozesse im Bereich erneuerbarer Energien und bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Team in die Umsetzung. Du steuerst die Realisierung mit Operations, Technik, Software und externen Partnern, bis die Lösung im Tagesgeschäft funktioniert. Du bewegst dich an der Schnittstelle von Prozessen, technischen Fragestellungen und Softwarethemen und bringst die richtigen Beteiligten zusammen. Du bist Teil eines kleinen, agilen Teams, übernimmst früh Verantwortung für eigene Themen und siehst unmittelbar, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Dein Profil Du studierst, befindest dich im Gap Year oder hast dein Studium kürzlich abgeschlossen, wobei die Fachrichtung zweitrangig ist. Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung gesammelt, idealerweise in einem Startup oder Scale-up, einer Beratung oder im Banking. Du bist umsetzungsstark, packst Themen an und bringst sie zum Abschluss. Du gehst strukturiert vor, denkst in Prozessen und behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten parallel den Überblick. Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein, auch wenn sie technisch werden. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch und kommunizierst klar und überzeugend mit Stakeholdern aus unterschiedlichsten Bereichen. Du möchtest nah am Geschehen sein und echten Impact haben und hast Lust, 3 bis 6 Monate mit dem Team vor Ort in Berlin zu arbeiten. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen. Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. Dein Extra-Boost - 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden. Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.

title: Business Analyst Intern (6 months) - 2027
description: Description There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon. At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact. You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure? What’s in it for you? An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus. Key job responsibilities You will test your analytical and technical skills. This internship is a learning opportunity, where you will put your skills and bias for action to the test, to complete a project that will support your own growth in the Business Analysis function, as well as the team and our customers' success. Partner with multiple teams across different geographies, building collaborative relationships while learning from experienced professionals in a global business environment. Take ownership of data analysis projects with guidance from mentors, turning data insights into actionable business recommendations. Identify and propose process improvement opportunities, working with the team to develop streamlined solutions that enhance business efficiency. Lead root cause analyses for assigned projects, collaborating with team members to solve real business challenges and implement solutions. Support the development of business cases for new programs, gaining hands-on experience in strategic planning and project development. Own the maintenance and improvement of specific performance metrics dashboards, while learning advanced visualization techniques from experienced analysts. Develop into a valued team member by bringing fresh perspectives and innovative ideas, while building foundation skills in business analysis. A day in the life Location: Berlin Start Date: Flexible between January - March 2027. We don't offer 2026 start dates. Duration: 6 months minimum This is not a remote internship opportunity Every day is different as a Business Analyst Intern. You'll work alongside experienced analysts and a dedicated mentor on real data analysis projects that directly impact business efficiency. You might spend your morning diving into datasets to perform a root cause analysis on an operational challenge, then spend your afternoon building and refining a performance metrics dashboard to track key business outcomes. You will partner with teams across different geographies, present data-driven recommendations, and contribute fresh perspectives to solve real business problems. Amazon is a data-driven business, so no matter which project you own, part of your role will involve turning raw data into actionable insights. You'll identify process improvement opportunities, support the development of business cases for new programs, and present your findings to senior stakeholders — building your analytical, technical, and strategic thinking skills in a fast-paced, global environment. Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date. About The Team Intern Community: As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests. Support The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive. Learning Sessions Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career. Opportunities Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits. Basic Qualifications Work 40 hours a week Speak, write, and read fluently in German Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc. Knowledge of SQL Currently in your penultimate or final year and working towards a university bachelor’s or master’s in Business Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics or a similar discipline Available for a full-time internship (40 hours/week) and commit to 6 month internship Preferred Qualifications Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process improvements and innovative solutions Excellent communication and teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with others. Demonstrated curiosity, proactivity, and willingness to take on challenges in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment. Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates. m/w/d Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. Company - Amazon Deutschland Services GmbH Job ID: A10560396

title: Group Services: Junior Projektmanager Transformation (m/w/d) – Vollzeit
description: Wenn Sie zu uns kommen, werden Sie Teil einer großen Familie: Als VITREA Deutschland gehören wir zur VITREA Gruppe, dem zweitgrößten Rehabilitationsanbieter Europas. Im Rahmen der Gruppe betreiben wir 80 stationäre und ambulante Einrichtungen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz und beschäftigen rund 14.000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter. In Deutschland betreiben wir 29 Rehakliniken, zwei Akutkliniken, acht ambulante Rehazentren, zwei Medizinische Versorgungszentren (MVZ), neun Pflegeeinrichtungen sowie ein Prevention Center. Zudem führen wir einen touristischen Standort in Damp. Jährlich entscheiden sich rund 66.000 Patientinnen und Patienten für eine stationäre Rehabilitation in unseren Einrichtungen; etwa 21.000 werden in unseren Akutbereichen behandelt, rund 37.000 besuchen unsere ambulanten Rehazentren und etwa 70.000 Patientinnen und Patienten werden in unseren MVZs betreut. In unseren Pflegeeinrichtungen versorgen wir rund 1.200 Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner. Insgesamt beschäftigen wir bei VITREA Deutschland über 9.000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter. Die VITREA Gruppe wächst und entwickelt sich kontinuierlich weiter. Unterschiedliche Standorte, Länder, Fachbereiche, Themenfelder und Systemlandschaften machen unser Umfeld vielseitig und dynamisch – von Bau- und Infrastrukturprojekten über Vertrags- und Organisationsthemen bis hin zu gruppenweiten Veränderungsinitiativen. Um in dieser Komplexität Transparenz, Struktur und Verlässlichkeit zu schaffen, suchen wir Unterstützung für unser Group Services Team. Sie helfen dabei, Informationen zusammenzuführen, Projekte zu koordinieren und sicherzustellen, dass Themen auch über dezentrale Strukturen hinweg im Blick bleiben. Ihre Aufgaben Unterstützung Leitungsteam – Sie unterstützen die Geschäftsführung und die zentralen Funktionen innerhalb VITREA Group Services (Systeme & Prozesse, Finanzen, Portfolio Management & Transformation) Projekt Management Unterstützung – Sie unterstützen bei der Planung, Koordination und Umsetzung laufender Projekte innerhalb der Group Services. Organisation – Sie bereiten Projekttermine vor und nach, dokumentieren Ergebnisse und unterstützen bi der Koordination interne sowie externe Projektbeteiligte. Monitoring & Tracking – Sie unterstützen bei der Nachverfolgung von Meilensteinen, Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und offenen Maßnahmen. Reporting & Dokumentation – Sie erstellen und pflegen Statusberichte, Präsentationen, Projektdokumentationen und Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Projektleitungen und Management. Standards & Prozesse – Sie unterstützen bei der Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung einheitlicher Methoden, Vorlagen und Prozesse im Projektmanagement. Ihr Profil Sie bringen idealerweise erste Erfahrung in der Projektassistenz oder im Projektmanagement – vorzugsweise im klinischen Umfeld bzw. im Gesundheitswesen – mit. Außerdem: Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Betriebswirtschaft, Gesundheitsmanagement oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Erste Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und betriebswirtschaftlichem Denken oder in der Projektkoordination Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Teams, Excel und PowerPoint Erfahrung mit Projektmanagement-Tools von Vorteil Affinität zu digitalen Systemen und Tools Kommunikationsstärke, Teamfähigkeit und Serviceorientierung im Umgang mit internen und externen Stakeholdern sowie im interdisziplinären Umfeld Strukturierte, zuverlässige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse Und sonst so? Die VITREA PlusCard: eine Zusatzkrankenversicherung mit umfassenden Serviceleistungen für Sie und Ihre Familie Corporate Benefits: dauerhafte Preisnachlässe auf Produkte und Dienstleistungen namhafter Anbieter Wir haben einen Rahmenvertrag mit BikeLeasing abgeschlossen und Sie können – bei Vorliegen der Voraussetzungen – ein Jobrad im Rahmen der Entgeltumwandlung leasen Group Services ist die zentrale Dienstleistungsorganisation der VITREA Gruppe für Reinigung, Catering und Logistik in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz. Sie haben noch Fragen? Erste Auskünfte erteilt Ihnen gerne unser Head of Group Services Herr Jens Knoblich, unter der Telefonnummer: +49 175 9212805 Bitte übersenden Sie uns Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen ausschließlich über das Karriereportal . Chancengleichheit im Beruf ist uns wichtig. Deshalb ermutigen wir ausdrücklich Menschen mit Behinderung, jeglicher geschlechtlichen Identität und Herkunft sich zu bewerben. Sie haben es sich sicher schon gedacht: Für alle Tätigkeiten in unseren Gesundheits- und Pflegeeinrichtungen ist ein gesetzlich vorgeschriebener Nachweis über eine Immunisierung gegen Masern erforderlich. Weiterhin brauchen Sie für bestimmte Tätigkeiten einen aktuellen Nachweis über die Hygieneschulung. VITREA Holding Deutschland GmbH Seeuferweg 10 | 24351 Damp | Deutschland
